jobs.title: Program Coordinator – Part-Time
jobs.description:
**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate two or more weekly tutoring clinics at Oakland school sites.
* Prepare tutoring spaces and materials so students and tutors are ready to work together.
* Pick up students from their classrooms and bring them to the tutoring clinic.
* Support volunteer tutors with scheduling, coaching, lesson planning, materials, encouragement, and student needs.
* Build positive relationships with students, tutors, families, teachers, and Children Rising staff.
* Monitor student progress and tutor\-student relationships and work with program leadership to address challenges.
* Track attendance and maintain accurate student and tutor records.
* Update program information in Salesforce.
* Collaborate with our FamilyBridge team to help connect tutoring, classroom learning, and support at home.
* Participate in program meetings, staff meetings, and special events as needed.

These responsibilities reflect the core duties in the current Children Rising job description.

**What we’re looking for**

* Two or more years of relevant education experience.
* A demonstrated ability and passion for working with children.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Experience responding constructively to student behavior and learning challenges.
* Comfort with program evaluation, data tracking, and learning new systems.
* Experience working with diverse communities.
* Experience supporting English\-language learners is a plus.
* Understanding of the impact of trauma on early\-childhood learning is a plus.

**Position details**

* Part\-time, approximately **10–20 hours per week** during the academic year.
* Work takes place primarily at Oakland school sites, with some work at the Children Rising office and remotely.
* Starting compensation is **$27/hour**, with the possibility of a higher starting rate based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated skills.
* Requires Live Scan background clearance, negative TB status, a valid driver’s license, and regular access to a car.

**About Children Rising**

Children Rising surrounds Oakland children with caring relationships and educational support so they can build stronger foundations in reading and math and greater confidence in themselves.

Through Succeeding by Reading, Path2Math, and FamilyBridge, students, families, volunteer tutors, schools, and community partners work together as part of a larger circle of care.

Job Types: Part\-time, Full\-time

Pay: From $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to complete Live Scan background clearance and provide verification of negative TB status? (Yes / No)
* Are you available to work approximately 10–20 hours per week, primarily during weekday school hours at Oakland school sites? (Yes / No)
* Do you have at least two years of experience working in education, tutoring, youth development, or a related field? (Yes/No)

Education:

* Associate (Required)

License/Certification:

* Driver's License (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Executive Search Program Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**Executive Search Program Coordinator (Contract Hourly) \- Hybrid**

  

Reporting to the Director of Global Executive Search, the Executive Search Program Coordinator plays a critical role in delivering a world\-class executive hiring experience. This individual serves as a trusted partner to the Executive Search team, senior leaders, executive assistants, candidates, and external search partners to ensure seamless execution of executive recruiting activities.


As the primary point of contact throughout the search process, you will represent Micron's Executive Search function and provide a high\-touch, white\-glove experience to executive\-level candidates. You will manage complex interview logistics, coordinate onboarding activities, support executive search operations, and drive strategic projects that enhance talent acquisition capabilities, processes, and candidate experience.


This role offers an opportunity to contribute beyond coordination by supporting talent mapping, market intelligence, executive talent pipelines, AI\-enabled recruiting initiatives, and process optimization projects that strengthen Micron's executive hiring strategy and future leadership pipeline.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Executive Search Coordination \& Candidate Experience**

* Coordinate and manage all aspects of the executive recruiting lifecycle, including candidate scheduling, interview coordination, offer support, and onboarding activities.
* Deliver an exceptional, white\-glove candidate experience while maintaining the highest levels of confidentiality, professionalism, and responsiveness throughout the search process.
* Serve as the primary liaison between executive candidates, hiring leaders, executive assistants, recruiters, and external search firms.
* Ensure timely communication, follow\-up, and execution of critical search\-related activities to keep searches progressing efficiently.
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve complex logistical challenges involving multiple executives and stakeholders across global time zones.
* Support executive candidate travel, interview preparation, and onboarding activities to ensure a seamless experience from initial engagement through hire.

 **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Partner closely with Executive Leadership teams, Executive Assistants, Human Resources, and external search firms to facilitate successful search execution.
* Manage relationships with external vendors and executive search partners, ensuring a high standard of service delivery, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Maintain alignment among stakeholders and provide regular search progress updates throughout the recruiting process.
* Build strong relationships across the organization to ensure efficient coordination and positive experiences for candidates and hiring teams.

 **Operations \& Process Excellence**

* Maintain executive search dashboards, candidate trackers, reporting tools, and recruiting systems, including Workday and LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Ensure accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of candidate, search, and reporting data.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, best practices, search reports, presentations, and executive recruiting resources.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the overall executive recruiting experience.
* Support executive search reporting, metrics, and analytics to drive informed decision\-making and operational excellence.

 **Strategic Projects, Talent Intelligence \& Market Insights**

* Support executive talent mapping, talent pool development, benchmarking initiatives, and market intelligence research.
* Assist in creating executive talent market maps, succession\-focused talent pipelines, and competitive intelligence reports.
* Contribute to strategic projects focused on candidate experience, employer brand, executive recruiting capabilities, and process innovation.
* Assist with analytics, reporting, and insights that inform executive talent acquisition strategies, workforce planning, and succession planning efforts.

 **AI \& Recruiting Innovation**

* Leverage AI\-powered recruiting and productivity tools to improve search execution, candidate experience, research, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Support the development and adoption of AI\-enabled workflows for executive talent mapping, market intelligence, candidate engagement, benchmarking, and search project management.
* Partner with the Executive Search team to identify opportunities to automate administrative tasks, streamline processes, and enhance reporting through AI and digital solutions.
* Utilize AI tools to synthesize market insights, develop executive and company profiles, create presentations, and support executive search analytics.
* Act as a champion for innovation by helping the Executive Search team leverage emerging technologies to enhance talent identification, research, workflow automation, and candidate engagement.
* Maintain awareness of emerging recruiting technologies, AI capabilities, talent intelligence platforms, and industry best practices to continuously advance the effectiveness of the Executive Search function.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Health PBM Operations Manager (Specialty Pharma, PBM)
jobs.description:
Accenture is a global leader in professional services, helping organizations worldwide transform their operations, enhance their growth, and deliver sustainable outcomes across industries. With a workforce of approximately 750,000 employees serving clients in over 120 countries, we are at the forefront of leveraging technology, data, AI, and innovation to drive meaningful change. Our blend of industry expertise, leadership in cloud, data, and AI, and a commitment to 360° value ensures that we help our clients deliver long\-lasting impact.

  



We collaborate with healthcare executives, leaders, and boards to help organizations innovate, transform, and enhance their operational effectiveness. Our work spans across strategy, operations, clinical optimization, regulatory compliance, and technological advancement. By combining industry knowledge with technology and data\-driven insights, we empower healthcare providers to achieve both operational excellence and clinical outcomes.

  



As a Health PBM Operations Manager, your primary responsibilities may include:

* Conduct assessments of clients' PBM operations to identify areas for optimization and growth
* Develop and support implementation of data\-driven strategies that align PBM operations with client organizational goals
* Apply pharmacy regulations and industry best practices to guide client compliance
* Evaluate and recommend technology solutions that improve PBM operations, including claims processing systems, data analytics, and automation tools
* Manage technology implementation workstreams and support integration into clients' existing operations
* Define key performance indicators (KPIs) with clients, support performance improvement plans, monitor impact, and recommend adjustments to enhance outcomes
* Coach and direct a team of consultants and analysts, fostering collaboration and continuous improvement
* Stay informed about health industry trends, emerging technologies, and changes in pharmacy regulations, and share insights and best practices

 **Travel**


Travel \- as needed, varies by client needs and could be up to 80%  

* 

  

**Why Join the Accenture Healthcare Team?**

* **Innovate Every Day:** Work at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, designing solutions that push boundaries and create transformative opportunities for healthcare organizations worldwide.
* **Lead with the Best:** Join an industry\-recognized healthcare consulting leader with a global team of over 20,000 professionals, collaborating to drive large\-scale healthcare transformation across the globe.
* **Continuous Learning \& Growth:** Take advantage of unmatched professional development opportunities, including interactive courses, real\-world client simulations, and ongoing mentoring, to expand your healthcare consulting expertise.

  

**Here’s what you need:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in PBM operations.
* Minimum of 3 years of consulting experience within the health industry with a focus on technology solutions.


Bonus points if you have:

* Experience working in a client\-facing environment to drive change.

jobs.title: Claims Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About 8Fleet**
----------------


8Fleet is a Los Angeles–based technology and logistics company building the operational infrastructure behind modern rideshare fleets. We operate in Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Atlanta and Miami, with more markets launching soon.

**About the Role**
------------------


At 8Fleet, claims sit at the intersection of fleet availability, driver experience, insurance costs, repair expenses, operational risk and company economics. Today our accident and vehicle\-incident claims run largely on manual workflows in Google Sheets. You'll manage those claims directly while building the claims function from the ground up: the processes, the standards and the reporting that turn claims data into decisions that save money.


This role sits on our Central Operations team and is based in Los Angeles or San Francisco.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own accident and vehicle\-incident claims across all markets, from first notice of loss through investigation, repair coordination, negotiation, settlement and closure.
* Build the incident intake and triage process, including what happens in the first 24 hours.
* Be the main contact for carriers, TPAs, adjusters and defense counsel, and hold them to clear expectations.
* Run subrogation and recovery as a real workstream.
* Partner with market leaders to turn accident trends and risk patterns into operational changes.
* Build claims reporting leadership can plan against: frequency, severity, cost per vehicle and open\-claim aging.
* Move claims onto a proper system and support insurance renewals with clean loss data.
* Keep us compliant with state requirements in CA, GA, FL and each new market.
* Build the team as volume grows.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 7\+ years in auto, fleet, transportation or commercial auto claims, including owning a claims function or program end to end.
* Experience with third\-party liability and bodily injury claims.
* Strong claim\-file judgment and experience working with TPAs and defense counsel.
* Confidence pushing back on carriers on reserves and coverage.
* Multi\-state experience, ideally including California.
* A methodical approach and comfort building process where none exists.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* AIC, SCLA, ARM or similar designation.
* Self\-insured or large\-deductible program experience.
* Fleet, rideshare, delivery or logistics background.
* People\-management experience.

**Compensation**
----------------


Base Salary: $130,000–$150,000 \+ equity

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------


8Fleet is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.About 8Fleet


Compensation Range: $130K \- $150K

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager, Operational Design
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.



This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

**THE ROLE**



Modernize how Everpure plans and delivers global marketing campaigns as we transform from static programs to dynamic, personalized buyer experiences. You will own the end\-to\-end campaign operations lifecycle—from request intake to production and launch—designing a fast, scalable execution engine. Sitting at the intersection of process design and MarTech, you will partner closely with Campaign Operations, Journey Orchestration, and regional marketing leaders across Americas, EMEA, and APJ. By applying workflow automation and AI to eliminate operational friction, you will dramatically accelerate time\-to\-market and empower global teams to deliver high\-impact results.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* **Optimize End\-to\-End Campaign Delivery:** Own and streamline the full execution lifecycle—from intake and prioritization to build, QA, and launch—establishing clear service level agreements (SLAs) and cross\-regional routing that increase marketing campaign velocity.
* **Build High\-Impact Intake \& Governance Systems:** Design structured, automated request workflows that capture required metadata upfront, minimize marketer effort, and govern reusable program templates and build standards across execution tools (Asana, Marketo, Splash).
* **Drive Enablement \& Continuous Improvement:** Partner with Marketing Operations enablement to roll out global process updates, maintain documentation, and deliver training programs that expand marketer self\-service capabilities.
* **Leverage Analytics \& AI for Scale:** Measure campaign operational performance (cycle time, throughput, rework rate) and build a prioritized roadmap integrating AI and automation to eliminate manual production tasks and boost campaign efficiency.
* We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**WHAT YOU BRING**


* **Process Design Expertise:** Proven experience designing, launching, and optimizing end\-to\-end operational workflows and request intake models for non\-technical, multi\-stakeholder teams.
* **Campaign Execution Fluency:** Hands\-on experience working within modern marketing technology stacks (including project management tools like Asana, marketing automation like Marketo, and event platforms like Splash) to build reliable, high\-volume production processes.
* **Workflow Automation \& AI Application:** Demonstrated capability applying automation platforms (such as Workato, Jira, or Asana workflows) and practical AI solutions to reduce manual build effort, optimize data routing, and scale operational output.
* **Global Change Management \& Analytics:** Track record of driving process adoption across international teams through structured enablement, paired with the ability to build operational dashboards, analyze bottleneck metrics, and deliver measurable delivery improvements.


\#LI\-ONSITE



\#LI\-MC3

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:**


* **Innovation**: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* **Growth**: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* **Team**: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.


**ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:**



Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you're invited to an interview.


**OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:**



We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.



Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.


**Join us and bring your best.**


**Bring your bold.**


**Pure and simple.**

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager, Wafer Fabrication, Raxium
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or Industrial), Materials Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience in manufacturing operations leadership and scheduling within a wafer fabrication facility.
* 10 years of experience in people management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration (MBA), or a related field.

**Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services**


At HH Global, we help the world's most recognized brands turn their growth ideas into measurable impact through responsible marketing activation. We are a global marketing activation partner that connects brands to their customers and delivers sustainable marketing activation at scale. With over 4,000 colleagues across more than 55 countries, you'll join a diverse, high\-performing community, empowered to deliver sustainable, innovative solutions for our clients.


**Purpose of the Job**


Our client offers a suite of devices and tools that are used daily by billions and trusted by over 6 million businesses. Our client’s Product Graphics team manages all on\-product artwork across their hardware portfolio—including brand identity, repairability, and regulatory compliance. They partner closely with Industrial Design, Product Safety \& Compliance, and Engineering to deliver seamless hardware experiences.


As a Product Graphics Program Manager, you will serve as the point of contact for end\-to\-end product graphics workflow, intake management, and project execution. You will bridge design and production to ensure visual quality, technical precision, and regulatory integrity across all physical product markings and labels. From receiving direction to driving strategy, you will establish operational rigor and cross\-functional alignment from concept through mass production. This role requires exceptional planning, adaptability, and the ability to balance multiple complex programs across global teams.


*This role is hybrid (3\+ days a week onsite), based in Mountain View, CA.*


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Program Governance \& Execution**
* + Own and partner with client teams for end\-to\-end program life cycles across hardware development gates.
	+ **Track and manage the Product Graphics Worklog from creation to archive, proactively identifying risks, mitigations, and schedule dependencies.**
	+ **Build and maintain single\-source\-of\-truth program documentation, including Program Decks, Graphics trackers, DRI matrices, and CMF Process Sketchbooks.**
	+ **Drive early technical readiness testing, such as laser mark feasibility and compliance alignment, ensuring timely reviews and client partner sign\-offs.**
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Communication**
* + Act as the central operational hub between our client’s Product Graphics Designers, Industrial Design (ID), CMF team, Hardware Engineering, Product Management, Compliance, and external manufacturing partners.
	+ Maintain an active in\-person presence to foster cross\-team client relationships, align stakeholder expectations, and drive consensus during critical build gates.
	+ Lead regular working sessions, track action items, and distribute clear, asynchronous program updates and status reports across global time zones.
	+ Represent the client team in critical meetings to track actions, milestones, and deliverables.
	+ Provide definitive resolution for program graphics decisions in the absence of cross\-functional alignment.
* **Process Strategy \& Operational Excellence**
* + Identify operational gaps in technical graphics workflows and build scalable, standardized frameworks to resolve bottlenecks.
	+ Drive quarterly task planning, backlog prioritization, and long\-term designer capacity and workload allocation.
	+ Manage physical sample requests, digital asset allocation, and procurement needs to support testing and client executive reviews.

**Knowledge, Skills \+ Experience**


Minimum Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or design\-related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience in hardware, product graphics, CMF, or consumer electronics
* Experience managing hardware development lifecycles and collaborating with manufacturing partners
  

Preferred Qualifications


* Proven track record of driving cross\-functional alignment across design, engineering, and compliance teams
* Deep technical understanding of manufacturing processes and capabilities, printing processes, and cosmetic finishing
* Strong organizational skills with proficiency in building clear decks, workflow trackers, and program frameworks
* Self\-starter capable of driving direction, resolving ambiguities, and influencing cross\-functional leadership without formal authority
* Ability to multitask, analyze opportunities, proactively solve problems and accomplish challenging objectives with minimal direction
* Effectively navigate and operate in a deadline\-driven, rapidly changing work environment
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality
* Possesses a love of efficiency, the desire to produce a high\-quality deliverable, and an ability to execute against multiple projects in a technical work environment with often uncertain circumstances

Requisition ID \# 174739
  
  

**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Danville; San Ramon
  
  

Department Overview
  
Applied Technology Services (ATS) has been providing technology\-based, innovative, high\-value services to the company for over 50 years. ATS is a multidisciplinary team of over 130 engineers, scientists, and technicians. The ATS vision is to be a forward\-thinking, technological leader providing high\-value solutions and services needed across the Company. ATS high value services also help proactively avoid future problems by specifying equipment, materials and methods that are best practices in the industry.
  
  

Position Summary
  
Leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of cross\-functional programs for technology evaluation including laboratory and field testing and analysis services. The successful candidate will ensure effective program execution through strong governance, data visibility, performance monitoring, and stakeholder alignment. Drives standardization of processes, establishes clear roles and accountability, and integrates workflows with enterprise data systems to enable consistent, scalable, and data\-driven decision\-making.
  
  

The selected candidate must live within PG\&E’s service territory.
  
  

PG\&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to these factors.​
  
  

**A reasonable salary range is:**  

Minimum Base Salary (Bay Area) $85,000\.00
  
Mid Base Salary (Bay Area) $106,000\.00
  
Maximum Base Salary (Bay Area) $127,000\.00
  
  

Job Responsibilities Maintains visibility to key program data, metrics, and performance trends; analyzes data to develop insights and recommendations for management Defines and tracks KPIs and performance metrics, supporting operating reviews and program governance to monitor risks and overall program health Develops and manages budgets, monitors performance against forecasts, and explains variances Leads cross\-functional projects and initiatives, prioritizing efforts in resource\-constrained environments Builds stakeholder alignment and accountability, collaborating across teams to resolve issues and drive program outcomes Leads development, standardization, and governance of programs and processes, including workflows, roles, and continuous improvement initiatives Establishes and maintains process documentation, tools, and standards to ensure consistency, quality, and scalability Drives integration of processes with enterprise systems and data sources
  
  

Qualifications
  
**Minimum:** Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience 3 years of job\-related experience
  
  

**Desired:** Master’s degree Experience defining and tracking KPIs, metrics, and performance dashboards PMI\-Project Management Institute or PMP\-Project Management Professional certification Knowledge of current utility and energy industry issues, industry trends and political, economic and social issues affecting the market. Knowledge of energy industry applications to local level customers, including energy issues, customer energy efficiency applications, and general customer information. Proficient with Microsoft Office products including Word, Excel, Access, Visio, Project, PowerPoint, PowerBI Proficient with the use of Artificial Intelligence including writing structured prompts, workflow integration, assisted research, and application of machine learning on large datasets

jobs.description:
**Company Overview:** Gexpro Services is a world\-class Supply Chain Services outsource provider, specializing in developing and managing production inventory management programs. Our managed inventory programs are designed to support manufacturing OEM’s with their engineered production material specifications, fulfillment, and quality requirements.

**Program Manager Benefits:** Gexpro Services offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Competitive compensation plus annual bonus
* Flexible work schedule
* Medical, dental, vision, life insurance and pet insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee assistance program and Health wellness programs
* 401(k) immediately with a competitive match.
* Several paid holidays and paid time off that includes personal, sick and vacation time.

**Program Manager Description:** The ideal Program Manager role will preferably possess a bachelor’s degree and/or have a combination of supply chain knowledge and relevant experience in a customer\-facing role. A qualified candidate should possess the ability to lead customer business review presentations on a variety of topics which may include but not limited to, on time delivery, sales trends, obsolesces inventory, cost saving initiatives, fulfillment solution projects, scope expansion and any other projects. It addition, the Program manager must be able to perform the following tasks:

  

* Develop a strategic and targeted customer service approach to attain and exceed annual sales quota and commercial margin rate of assigned customer account worth at least $1M in annual sales.
* Cultivate and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with assigned customers by understanding needs, objectives, and pain points to manage their supply chain.
* Manage discrete, ILM, VMI and/or consignment inventory program(s), assessing the risks and opportunities, while consistently improving the fulfillment process.
* Provides customer account management which may include, but is not limited to tactical supports such, order entry, order inquiry, product information, order status, pricing, inventory inquiries, customer fulfillment and transportation management to analyze and resolve customer needs.
* Provides strategic account management which include more complex support such as forecasting, monitoring negative transactions, overall profitability and completing all contractual obligations.
* Working independently and/or with cross\-functional team members to resolve complex escalations from customer such as resolve shortages, possible line down, quality issues.
	+ Such as the NCNR and/RAM process
* Guarantee parts are ordered timely to insure on\-time delivery.
* Drive process improvements within assigned customer base.
* Resolve escalated/complex customer inquiries concerning shipment problems, order changes, invoice variations, etc., using root\-cause analysis.
* May attend/lead quarterly business review with internal team members or external customer and suppliers to provide performance and inventory updates to assigned customer base.
* Ensure prompt payment on invoicing for assigned customer base.
* Own execution of deflationary effort for assigned customer base, if needed.
* Review customer forecast and usage through data analysis to show current trends and predict future trends to prepare correct stocking levels with consideration to lead times.
* Provide technical and product knowledge support to supplier and customer base as needed to ensure account is properly maintained.
* In some cases, the Program Manager may have management responsibilities of a small team of Warehouse Leaders, Inside Sales Representatives and/or Project Managers \- Sales.
* Other duties as assigned by Senior Program Manager, Service Site Manager and/or Service Center Manager.

 **Program Manager Requirements:** The Program Manager should preferably possess a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in a customer\-facing role within the supply chain industry OR an equivalent combination of education and experience within the supply chain industry in program management/sales/service capacities owning program strategy and end to end delivery. The ideal candidate should posses the ability to define and execute against program requirements. The Program Manager should possess a combination of proven product and application knowledge, negotiation skills, interpersonal skills, effective communication skills, organization skills, and problem\-solving skills to drive decisions with influence presenting to senior executive.

jobs.title: Program Manager Evaluation & Learning
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------



The Program Manager of Evaluation \& Learning is a core member of CCSCC's Organizational Effectiveness team, responsible for leading CCSCC's outcomes measurement and continuous improvement work across all CCSCC programs.



This role builds and maintains the systems, tools, and culture that allow the agency to understand whether programs are producing desired outcomes, communicate results to funders and the Board, and use data to improve decision\-making.



The Program Manager partners closely with program leadership, IT/CIS staff, and accreditation or compliance leads to ensure that data collection, measurement, and reporting are embedded in daily operations.



This is a strategic and hands\-on role responsible for developing evaluation frameworks, creating reporting infrastructure, analyzing data, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Outcomes Measurement \& Evaluation Strategy**


* Lead the design and ongoing refinement of an agency\-wide outcomes measurement framework, including logic models and theories of change.
* Collaborate with internal teams to create, implement, review, and use theories of change, program models, journey maps, and other strategy and evaluation tools.
* Define meaningful, measurable outcomes and process indicators.
* Collaborate with outside partners when appropriate, including research institutions and evaluation partners.
* Design, implement, and oversee evaluation plans for individual programs, including data collection methodologies, measurement protocols, sampling, and analysis methods.
* Co\-design and lead evaluation of the Vision 2030 Strategic Plan and other strategic initiatives.
* Establish and measure baseline KPIs and monitor progress across the organization.
* Conduct research and analysis to identify and implement best practices in evaluation and outcomes measurement.

### **Training \& Capacity Building**


* Train program leadership to run reports, analyze data, assess outcomes, and develop meaningful narratives.
* Design and facilitate training sessions on evaluation and learning topics, including logic models, measurement frameworks, data interpretation, and visualization.
* Create and deliver evaluation and learning onboarding training for program leadership staff.
* Foster a culture where data informs program design and continuous quality improvement.

### **Data Systems, Analysis \& Reporting**


* Analyze program activity, outcome, and impact data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports for staff, executive leadership, the Board, and funders.
* Lead creation and validation of agency\-wide reports, including accreditation and annual reporting requirements.
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives for non\-technical audiences.
* Partner with IT/CIS and program teams to ensure data systems support consistent and reliable reporting.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues, workflow gaps, and integration needs.
* Provide technical support and guidance related to data collection and management tools.
* Maintain documentation of data definitions, workflows, and reporting processes.

### **Cross\-Program Collaboration \& Community Engagement**


* Partner with compliance and quality assurance staff to understand reporting and outcome requirements.
* Support standardization of measurement practices across program areas while accommodating program\-specific needs.
* Lead referral tracking and process\-mapping efforts that intersect with outcomes measurement.
* Coordinate with accreditation leads to ensure measurement practices meet external standards.
* Develop research protocols and engagement strategies that involve community members, donors, and funders.
* Conduct literature reviews and research to inform program development and organizational strategy.
* Represent CCSCC in meetings and presentations with internal and external stakeholders.
* Support agency\-wide strategic planning through data and evaluation expertise.

### **Staff Supervision \& Development**


* Supervise, coach, and develop Data Analyst(s), interns, and other assigned staff.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management activities.
* Provide ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
* Conduct regular supervision and team meetings.

### **Financial Management \& Fund Development**


* Manage assigned Evaluation \& Learning budgets and resources.
* Collaborate with program and development leaders to identify funding opportunities.
* Support grants and contracts through timely completion of deliverables and reporting.

### **Funder \& External Reporting**


* Prepare outcome and impact data for grant reports, site visits, and public\-facing communications.
* Support program leadership in creating compelling, data\-informed narratives.
* Ensure evaluation methods and reporting comply with funder and accreditation requirements.

### **Policy Development \& Implementation**


* Develop and improve policies and procedures that support high\-quality service delivery.
* Collaborate with agency leadership on communications and strategic planning initiatives.
* Inform community partners about gaps, barriers, and opportunities identified through evaluation efforts.

**Qualifications**
------------------


### **Required**


* Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Social Work, Public Policy, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* 3 to 5\+ years of experience in program evaluation, data analysis, or outcomes measurement.
* Experience developing logic models, theories of change, and evaluation frameworks.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, reporting tools, or business intelligence platforms.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted technologies to support reporting, analysis

Job description:


Mirapath designs, procures, installs and manages the technology infrastructure of many large businesses around the globe. Fortune 500 and Silicon Valley 150 companies including Adobe, Cisco, Google, HP, LinkedIn, Tesla, and Twitter trust us for their data center needs. Founded in 2003, we are 100% Women Owned. We’ve earned many company recognitions, including Fast 100 Asian American Business (2017, 2018, 2025\) and Silicon Valley Business Journal Fast Private (2018\).


The **Project Manager** is responsible for managing and overseeing projects within our Professional Services division. This position serves as the frontline manager on projects, and they must be able to discuss technical and non\-technical aspects of projects with managers, technicians, customers, external constituents, and others. Position has overall responsibility for management, implementation and tracking of short\- and long\-term service projects. This is a critical point position – acts as liaison to all departments, quick to anticipate issues, solve problems and sets the pace, quality and success of the project. The ideal candidate for this role will be capable of full\-cycle project management, behave ethically, communicate effectively, create/innovate, foster teamwork, make decisions, organize, plan and solve problems by following the Mirapath values: **Relationships Matter, Commitment to Excellence, Results Driven and Strive for Innovation and Knowledge**.

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management**

* Work closely with the Director of Services to manage project execution across departments for all phases: project kick\-off, scope and requirements gathering, cost, scheduling (labor and timelines), materials coordination and project risks.

**Customer Engagement**

**Education and Experience**

* 5\+ years of Project Management experience

* Business, IT knowledge and experience working in professional services, technology, engineering and/or construction industry

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations, Office of the CCO
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



The Office of the Chief Commercial Officer is a small team that works directly with our CCO, go\-to\-market leadership, and company leadership on Anthropic’s highest\-priority commercial initiatives. We take on problems that do not sit cleanly inside one team, such as standing up a program that spans Product, Finance, Legal, and Sales, or preparing the material our executives and Board use to make decisions. Our commercial business is growing faster than its operating processes can be built, so a growing share of the job is stepping into gaps and running something important, while making sure other teams are building the capabilities to permanently own.



You will own workstreams end to end. One week that means running the go\-to\-market side of a pressing situation, from the communications plan for customers and account teams to the daily readout for executives. Another week it means building the analysis behind a resourcing decision or a new program and writing it up for the CCO. This is an internal role. You will report to the CCO’s chief of staff, and you will have an unusually broad view of how the company makes decisions.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* Drive priority go\-to\-market initiatives from plan to delivery, removing blockers, escalating early, and connecting the right people across teams at the right time
* Build the analysis, draft the document or deck, and turn input from many teams into a recommendation executives can act on
* Prepare content for the CCO and leadership team, including weekly staff meetings, updates to the Office of the CEO, Board materials, and leadership offsites
* Track the go\-to\-market organization’s top priorities and keep a current view of status, owners, and risks
* Act as a bridge between go\-to\-market and Product, Finance, Legal, Safeguards, and Research, so that what account teams hear from customers reaches product decisions and those decisions reach account teams in a usable form
* Step in where something important has no clear owner, run it until it has a permanent home, and hand it over cleanly
* Close out same\-day executive requests quickly and to a high standard

**You may be a good fit if you:**
---------------------------------


* Have 4\+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy and operations, a chief of staff team, or a similarly rigorous environment working with senior executives
* Structure ambiguous problems well and get to a clear recommendation
* Can get to a number yourself in a spreadsheet, in SQL, or with Claude, check it against a second source, and explain where it came from
* Write and speak clearly and briefly for executive audiences
* Are as willing to maintain the tracker and chase the last open items as to write the strategy
* Are comfortable with significant autonomy and with priorities that shift on short notice, pay close attention to detail, and know when to escalate
* Build trust quickly with senior people across the company who are short on time
* Use AI tools as a core part of how you work
* Care about Anthropic’s mission and about getting safe, useful AI to customers

### **Strong candidates may also have**


* Experience in technology, SaaS, or enterprise software, or exposure to go\-to\-market strategy, sales operations, or customer success
* Experience running a product launch, a program office, or another cross\-functional effort with many owners and a fixed date
* Familiarity with how large enterprises buy and adopt technology, including security, legal, and procurement review
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.



For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.


Annual Salary:


$190,000 \- $270,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------


**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience


**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience


**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position


**Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.


**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.


**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  

  

**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresse

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Summary
We're partnering with a well\-established, employee\-owned mechanical contractor that's continuing to grow its Northern California operations and is looking to add an experienced Project Manager to its team.


This role offers the opportunity to manage large\-scale commercial construction projects while working alongside experienced preconstruction, engineering, and field teams. The company has a strong pipeline of upcoming projects, providing long\-term stability and opportunities for continued growth.


We're seeking candidates with a strong commercial construction background who can manage projects from planning through completion. HVAC or plumbing experience is preferred but not required.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout
* Oversee project budgets, forecasting, schedules, and cost control
* Coordinate with owners, general contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and field teams
* Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, and contract administration
* Oversee procurement, material deliveries, and project milestones
* Lead project meetings and maintain strong relationships with clients and project stakeholders
* Work closely with Superintendents and field teams to maintain project schedules and quality standards
* Identify project risks, resolve construction challenges, and support value engineering
* Mentor and support Project Engineers and other project team members

**Requirements**
----------------

* 4–5\+ years of commercial construction experience preferred, including project management responsibilities
* Experience managing projects for a general contractor or specialty subcontractor
* HVAC, plumbing, or mechanical construction experience preferred but not required
* Strong understanding of project budgeting, scheduling, forecasting, and cost control
* Experience managing subcontractors, procurement, change orders, and project documentation
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contracts
* Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, MS Project, or similar construction software preferred
* Strong leadership, communication, and problem\-solving skills
* Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred, or equivalent construction experience

**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------

* 100% employee\-owned company (ESOP)
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid holidays, sick leave, and vacation
* Training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities
* Opportunity to lead large\-scale commercial and healthcare projects

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.  

  

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.  

  

Our capabilities include programs, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.  

We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**  

The purpose of this position is to lead individual, multi\-disciplined real estate project solutions for clients, with direct accountability for project delivery.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manages all facets of project management (budget, schedule, procurement, quality \& risk) for individual real estate projects including planning, design, construction, occupancy and closeout.
* Demonstrates capability to read, understand and apply standard documents affecting real estate projects, including but not limited to: agreements/contracts, leases, work letters, project charters, surveys and drawings.
* Interfaces directly with clients to define project requirements. Prepares scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimate \& budget, work plan schedule \& milestones, quality control, and risk identification.
* Identifies project delivery resources from pre\-qualified lists; Conducts simple request for proposals; completes bid analysis with management support. Recommends resources to clients.
* Leads project delivery resources/team (typically smaller team) providing project guidance and direction to achieve project goals.
* Implements communication plan for meetings and written reports/meeting minutes to keep client and project resources informed. Facilitates project meetings.
* Implements project documentation governance aligned with company and client requirements. Ensures project data integrity and documentation is accurate, timely and coordinated.
* Tracks progress of each project against goals, objectives, approved budgets, approved timelines. Reports status and variances. Creates action plans to meet objectives, budget and schedule.
* Implements change management routines to assess change requests, make recommendations, secure Client approvals, and issue change orders. Assesses change requests to determine impacts to scope, budget, schedule, quality and risk with management support.
* Implements standard risk management routines with management support, to identify project risks, develop risk mitigation and contingency plans, and implement action plans to reduce or eliminate project risks. Other duties as assigned.
* Manages 3rd party project delivery resources/team (typically smaller team). Responsible for tracking performance and motivating team members.

 **Qualifications**  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS/BEng/BArch) from College or University and/or equivalent related experience.
* Prior Project Management experience is preferred.
* PMP (US and/or Canada) and LEED AP preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and analytical skills. Ability to provide efficient, timely, reliable and courteous service to customers. Ability to effectively present information.

jobs.title: Music Content Operations AIML Program Lead
jobs.description:
A job at Apple is unlike any other you've had. You'll be challenged. You'll be inspired. And you'll be proud.  

  

Apple Music is looking for a Music Content Operations AIML Program Lead to help drive our strategic initiative to scale music content operations through models, agents, and automation. You'll lead the transition of music curation from a primarily manual operation toward a hybrid system where agents handle day\-to\-day work and human expertise is focused where it matters most \- high\-priority, high\-risk, and quality\-critical decisions. This is a full\-time individual contributor role on our Content Operations team, reporting into Music Content Operations leadership.  

  

Sitting at the intersection of operations and advanced technology, you'll serve as the technical liaison between our operational workflows and the data science and engineering teams building the models, tools, and agentic systems that scale this work far beyond what manual review can achieve alone. You'll partner with engineering to develop agents, help establish the key infrastructure to support and integrate them, and define how humans stay in the loop as that infrastructure matures. You'll translate messy operational reality \- everything from track\-level metadata quirks to editorial judgment calls \- into crisp technical requirements, evaluate the solutions that come back, and decide what ships.  

  

**Description**  

  

Own the strategy and execution plan to scale curation through models, agents, and automation \- sequencing workstreams by impact and driving them from concept to production. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to develop agents that take on day\-to\-day curation work, from defining requirements through evaluation and production rollout. Help establish the key infrastructure to support, integrate, and orchestrate agents over time \- shaping how agentic systems plug into existing curation workflows and data. Define the future operating model for curation \- determining where agents handle work autonomously and where humans stay in the loop for high\-priority, high\-risk, or quality\-assessment cases, including review of agent output. Translate operational challenges into clear, actionable specifications that engineering and data science teams can execute against. Break down ambiguous problems into well\-scoped, prioritized workstreams, sequenced by impact. Start with the highest\-leverage slice; iterate from there. Evaluate technical proposals and model outputs \- participate in design reviews and build eval frameworks (golden sets, quality metrics, error analysis, human\-in\-the\-loop feedback) to judge whether AI/ML and agentic solutions are ready for production. Design and iterate on human\-in\-the\-loop tooling that surfaces agent and model outputs (confidence scores, candidate matches, suggested labels, risk signals) so reviewers can validate high\-stakes decisions with speed and accuracy. We have an exciting full\-time opportunity for an **Admissions \& Program Operations Coordinator** at El Chante, our licensed 20\-bed residential substance use treatment program serving adult men in Oakland, Alameda County.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.


We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


We’re looking for a self\-driven, growth\-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid\-remote US\-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back\-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one our fastest growing customer segments.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions\-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in\-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross\-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross\-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long\-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2\+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota\-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self\-motivated, and detail\-oriented; great follow\-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market
jobs.description:
**About Hyperbound**
--------------------


Deals are messy. Multiple stakeholders, hours of calls, and endless emails. At Hyperbound, we're building the AI Agent that will help sales teams untangle that mess.


Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.  

  

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.


We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Bloomberg, Supabase, Monday.com, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

**About the role**
------------------


You'll own a book of 25 to 40 mid\-market customers ($20k to $100k\+ ARR) and be their day\-to\-day owner at Hyperbound. Your job is to get them live, get their reps using the product.

**What we need from you**
-------------------------

* **Technical depth**: You can debug, trace and reproduce a bug. You go to product or engineering when a problem is below the UI, not because you didn't want to look.
* **Relationship instinct**: You know the key people at every account, they know you, and they message you before they message anyone else. You understand what each customer is trying to fix and you build the plan around that.
* **Ownership**: When something goes wrong, you name the problem, and start solving it. You only pull in more people if required.
* **Conviction**: You push back. When a customer wants to skip the rollout plan, run the wrong cadence, or launch to the whole sales org on day one, you tell them why it won't work and sell them on the approach that will. Customers respect solutions that are sold to them, not handed over. You own the implementation and the outcome, not just the setup.

**Highly preferred**
--------------------

* Background in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM ops. You've rolled out a tool or a methodology to a sales team before and know what it takes to get reps to actually use it.
* Experience implementing or administering Hyperbound or a similar sales coaching platform.

**What your regular Thursday looks like:**
------------------------------------------

* **Implementation**: Own the project plan from kickoff to first live cohort. Rollout design, integrations setup, SSO and SCIM, admin training, launch date.
* **Adoption**: Regular check\-ins, usage reviews, feature demos, and behaviour\-change plays that get reps practising and managers coaching.
* **First\-line technical support**: Discovery on the call, reproduce the issue, file a clean ticket. Solve what can be solved in the UI or a playbook yourself.
* **Voice of the customer**: Own feedback from your accounts and make sure it reaches the product.
* **Health monitoring**: Watch active users, caller counts, and implementation milestones so you act on a slipping account weeks before the renewal conversation, not during it.
* **Commercial signals**: Spot expansion and renewal risk, log it, and hand it to the account manager who owns pricing and paper.
* **Responsiveness**: Fast on Slack, tickets, and email.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* A tag\-team job. You go to customer meetings alone. Bringing a second person is the exception.
* A sales job. Retention comes first. Expansion signals get logged and handed over, not chased. A commercial role. You don't price, negotiate, or own renewal paper. You will be paired with an expansion Account manager who will take care of that.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Comfortable with the technical side: reading logs, reproducing bugs, working through configuration, and explaining a technical issue clearly to both a customer and an engineer. You don't need to be an engineer.
* You broadly understand how a sales team runs: quotas, onboarding, coaching cadences.
* You remove blockers yourself rather than routing customers to another team.
* You can run around 40 accounts and treat them differently on purpose.

**Interview Plan**
------------------

* 30 min call with James, Recruiter
* 30 min call with Keshav, Product Lead
* Take home exercise (1\-3 hours)
* Take home exercise review call (45 min)
* Final interview with Co Founders and team

**Compensation and Benefits**

* $130K\-$160k OTE
* Series A equity
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free lunch and dinner in the office
* Commuter benefits


We move fast, from first conversation to offer in 1\-2 weeks

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The Outside Account Management team at DoorDash partners with restaurant merchants to help them grow simply and profitable on the platform. Our mission is to support merchants throughout their journey – ensuring a positive experience while also helping them unlock meaningful growth opportunities. We work closely with merchants to understand their goals, solve operational challenges, and recommend growth strategies that fit their business – balancing thoughtful partnership with commercial impact.


**About the Role**
------------------



As a **Strategic Partner Manager II (SPM)**, you will own and grow relationships with a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, operating with a high degree of autonomy and strategic judgment. You'll lead complex, high\-impact partnerships focused on driving long\-term growth, profitability, and retention for merchants on the DoorDash platform.



In this role, you'll move beyond day\-to\-day account management to guide more strategic merchant conversations—helping partners think holistically about growth, operations, and how to scale their business with DoorDash. You'll proactively adapt account plans as opportunities and challenges emerge, identify and address risks early, and consistently drive measurable outcomes across your book of business.



Beyond your own accounts, you'll play an influential role across the team — serving as a voice of the merchant internally, shaping cross\-functional initiatives, and sharing best practices that elevate how DoorDash partners with restaurants at scale.



You'll report to a regional manager within Outside Account Management. We expect this role to be flexible, with time split between traveling to merchants and additional flexibility to work remotely from home or a DoorDash office.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Own and grow strategic partnerships:** Manage a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, consistently driving measurable growth, retention, and satisfaction
* **Lead advanced merchant strategy:** Conduct high\-impact business reviews focused on larger\-scale growth strategies, profitability, and long\-term success
* **Operate autonomously:** Proactively adjust account plans and growth strategies as merchant needs, performance, and market conditions evolve
* **Identify and mitigate risk:** Anticipate detractors, address challenges early, and implement solutions to protect merchant health and performance
* **Drive expansion and optimization:** Recommend and sell DoorDash products that support merchant growth, efficiency, and brand perception
* **Influence cross\-functionally:** Partner with Product, Operations, Sales, and other teams—driving action and outcomes without relying on manager escalation
* **Represent the merchant internally:** Surface meaningful merchant insights each quarter to inform product improvements, GTM strategy, and internal initiatives
* **Elevate the team:** Share best practices, provide feedback on decks and negotiation strategy, and support the development of Partner Managers

**We're excited about you because you have…**
---------------------------------------------


* **4\+ years of experience** in account management, customer success, or post\-sales roles with increasing scope and autonomy
* Proven track record of driving measurable growth and retention across the majority of a book of business
* Strong executive presence with the ability to command a room, influence without authority, and deliver compelling presentations
* Deep understanding of the restaurant and hospitality industry, including merchant P\&L and unit economics
* Advanced analytical skills, including maintaining complex spreadsheets and performing data analysis using tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, Tableau, or Sigma
* Strong knowledge of third\-party delivery platforms, logistics, and multi\-sided marketplaces
* Ability to synthesize data, industry trends, and merchant insights into clear, actionable recommendations
* Collaborative mindset with experience serving as a trusted partner and informal mentor within a team

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities.
