jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.



We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.



To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.



Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one\-of\-a\-kind vibrancy into our culture.



If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.


As a Customer Success Manager in our Enterprise team you will be part of a team managing some of the world's biggest and most recognizable brands.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Partner with Account Executives to ensure commercial alignment \& drive client renewals, retention \& net retention targets for your customers
* Be your customers' main point of contact and trusted advisor at Braze
* Drive feature adoption by building a shared Success Plan with your customers, providing strategic guidance, enablement, and day\-to\-day advice to help them hit their objectives with Braze
* Drive customer advocacy by building strong customer relationships and creating mutual value for your customers and Braze
* Proactively analyze your customer product usage to identify opportunities and risks to account health
* Maintain ongoing regular contact with your customers via ad\-hoc communications, regular check\-ins, events, and Executive Business Reviews.
* Advocate for your customers, soliciting and synthesizing customer product feedback to contribute to product development
* Provide continuing education for customers to maximize product usage, identifying new or unused Braze features that could provide value for your customer and represent an upsell opportunity for Braze.
* In addition to being a dedicated contact for strategy, product training inquiries, and non\-technical support, you will coordinate with other Braze teams including Technical Support, Industry Solutions, and Deliverability Services to ensure your customers receive the support they need simply and seamlessly
* Work with Onboarding Managers and other Customer Success Partners to seamlessly transition clients from onboarding to ongoing activity.
* You will likely spend time onsite with customers and may travel \[internationally]


Please note this job description cannot possibly cover every duty you may need to undertake, you may be asked by your line manager to handle other reasonable responsibilities commensurate with the role.


**WHO YOU ARE**



You are passionate about customer success and find satisfaction in helping your customers achieve great things. You have a proven track record in customer success and are seeking to progress your career, with one of the industry's most advanced customer success teams, by working with established, household\-name, enterprise customers with over 1,000 employees.


* You are an excellent communicator with exemplary written and verbal communication skills coupled with unparalleled follow up skills. Clients and colleagues have the impression that you listen and understand the strategic problems they are trying to solve
* You're excited by working with medium and large technology companies who move fast, and want to build new customer experiences quickly
* You're known for being a "team player." We just can't emphasize this enough
* You build great relationships with colleagues and customers
* You have a high level of intellectual curiosity. You see opportunity and growth in learning more about what you do and how it impacts others
* You have experience successfully managing complex accounts or projects with sophisticated clients, multiple stakeholders, and competing priorities
* You have excellent time management skills
* You have domain knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, APIs, Marketing Automation, Direct Marketing, Marketing Analytics or Programming (HTML etc
* 2\-5 years relevant experience in a related area, for example Onboarding, Customer Success, Implementations or Project Management


For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $94,620 \- $102,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $114,275 \- $120,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, Braze offers full and part\-time employees a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that all Braze employees own a piece of our company.


**WHAT WE OFFER**


*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*



From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work\-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:


* Competitive compensation that may include equity
* Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
* Flexible paid time off
* Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
* Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
* Professional develop

The Account Manager oversees a janitorial team executing a high level of customer care for a single client location in the Cleveland area. The Account Manager oversees all daily operations of the janitorial team and will ensure a safe and respectful work environment for all.



Key Responsibilities


* Directs and manages key operational functions

jobs.title: Community Health Worker - Bilingual (Spanish) -San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
**Planned Parenthood Northern California (PPNorCal)** is seeking a bilingual (Spanish) Community Health Worker in San Francisco, CA. This role is full\-time, 40 hours per week. PPNorCal offers a comprehensive benefits package, including 100% employer\-paid medical insurance for full\-time employees, 75% coverage for dependent children, 25% coverage for spouses/domestic partners, dental and vision insurance, employer\-paid life and long\-term disability coverage, earned time off (ETO) and paid sick time accrued based on hours worked, a 403(b) retirement plan with up to 4% employer match after 12 months, and 10 paid holidays plus 2 floating holidays each year. **Work Schedule**  

Monday: 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM  

Tuesday: 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM  

Wednesday: 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM  

Thursday: 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM  

Friday: 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM* flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends, as business needs require

  

**This position is currently represented by SEIU Local 1021\.**  

***APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:*** After review of your application, resume and qualifications, you may be invited to the next phase of the selection process, which includes a pre\-recorded video interview, responding to screening questions. If you are being invited to do the video interview, you will receive an email and text with the video platform link and will have 5 days to complete this video interview*.*

**SUMMARY**
The Community Health Worker (CHW) serves as a trusted liaison between Planned Parenthood Northern California (PPNorCal), patients, and the communities we serve. The CHW improves access to healthcare, reproductive health services, and community resources by providing culturally responsive patient resource navigation, health education, outreach, advocacy, and care coordination.
Working collaboratively with health center staff and community partners, the CHW addresses social determinants of health (SDOH), promotes health equity, and supports PPNorCal's mission of providing inclusive, high\-quality reproductive healthcare. The CHW serves as an integrated member of the care team while fostering meaningful relationships that improve health outcomes and expand access to care. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
The essential duties listed below are representative of the primary responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list. Additional duties may be assigned based on operational needs. **Patient Support Services*** Build trusting relationships with patients through culturally responsive, trauma\-informed, and patient\-centered care utilizing active listening and motivational interviewing techniques
* Assess patient needs and assist with identifying and reducing barriers to healthcare access
* Connect patients with internal and external resources, including food, housing, transportation, legal services, behavioral health, care coordination, telehealth, and other community supports
* Assist patients with MyChart enrollment, scheduling follow\-up appointments, insurance verification, enrollment applications, and access to healthcare services
* Maintain current knowledge of Medi\-Cal, Family PACT, and other health coverage programs to assist patients with eligibility, enrollment, renewal, and ongoing access to benefits
* Provide ongoing follow\-up and support to patients as appropriate

 **Community Outreach \& Partnerships*** Develop, maintain, and strengthen collaborative relationships with community\-based organizations (CBOs), schools, healthcare providers, advocacy organizations, and other community partners
* Represent PPNorCal at community events, outreach activities, health fairs, coalition meetings, and educational forums
* Identify partnership opportunities that expand access to reproductive health education and community resources
* Support grassroots outreach and community engagement efforts that increase awareness of PPNorCal services and programs

 **Health Education \& Advocacy*** Deliver culturally and linguistically appropriate health education related to sexual and reproductive health, disease prevention, vaccinations, STI prevention, wellness, and available community resources, this may include bilingual presentations
* Encourage patient self\-advocacy through education, resource connection, and health literacy
* Promote health equity by addressing social determinants of health and advocating for equitable access to healthcare services

 **Documentation, Reporting \& Program Support*** Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential documentation in accordance with organizational policies, HIPAA requirements, and grant requirements
* Track patient encounters, outreach activities, community partnerships, and program outcomes using assigned technology and reporting systems
* Collect and document patient impact stories and program data to support grant reporting, quality improvement initiatives, and program evaluation
* Assist with grant\-related activities, including narrative development and program documentation, as assigned

 **Team Collaboration*** Function as an integrated member of the health center team by completing cross\-training in designated clinical and operational workflows to support patient care and health center operations
* Collaborate with internal multidisciplinary teams – including Telehealth, Care Coordination, Patient Navigation, and Behavioral Health – to coordinate patient care and facilitate referrals
* Utilize electronic health records (EHR), patient management systems, Microsoft Office applications, and other assigned technology to perform job responsibilities effectively
* Participate in organizational initiatives supporting Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Belonging, and health equity
* Perform other duties as assigned

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS*** High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Associate's in Public Health, Social Work, Health Education, Human Services, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of ed

jobs.title: Resident Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position: Resident Care Coordinator**


Sunday \- Thursday


Pay Range: $28\.00 \- $33\.00


**Oakmont of Burlingame** is a premier senior living community situated on a beautifully landscaped campus. Managed by Oakmont Management Group,we provide exceptional quality, comfort, and care with five\-star services and amenities. Residents enjoy a rewarding lifestyle with individualized comprehensive support that promotes continuing independence. *We deliver meaningful lifestyles and relationships with residents, families, and team members by developing a winning culture and living these values: Authenticity \* Teamwork \* Compassion \* Commitment \* Resilience.*


**With communities across California,** **Colorado,** **Hawaii, and Nevada, opportunities for career growth, relocation, and travel are significant. In addition, eligible team members may enjoy the following benefits:**


* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
* Vacation, Personal Day, Sick Pay, Holidays
* Complimentary Meals
* Bonus Opportunities
* Company Paid Life Insurance
* Team Member Discount Program (LifeMart)
* 401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match
* Recognition Programs
* Student Loan Refinancing
* Pet Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Emergency Financial Assistance


**The Resident Care Coordinator** is responsible for the coordination of resident care and staffing necessary to meet the needs of all residents.


**Responsibilities:**


* Communicate with community healthcare professionals, including physicians, discharge planners, nurses, and state agencies on the care needs of residents as needed.
* Assist the Health Services Director in coordinating incidental medical, dental, vision, hearing, and podiatry care for residents and arrange resident escorts s needed
* Participate in the community’s resident assessment program in accordance with company policy and state regulations.
* Recruit, develop, manage and schedule Care Providers and Medication Technicians.
* Maintain a safe and secure environment for all staff, residents, and guests, following established safety standards.
* Encourage teamwork through cooperative interactions with co\-workers and other departments.


**Qualifications**:


* Must be at least eighteen (18\) years of age.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

jobs.title: Client Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Client Care Coordinator**  

Front Desk \& Client Experience \| Fremont, CA \| Full\-Time \| In Person


Are you the kind of person who remembers names, notices when someone seems nervous, and loves making people feel welcome the moment they walk in?


Do people tell you that you make things feel easy, even when their day has been anything but?


Competitive Edge Physical Therapy recently launched our 4th Bay Area clinic in Fremont, and we're looking for a Client Care Coordinator to be the heart of the front desk. You'll be the first smile our clients see, the voice they hear on the phone, and the person who guides them from their first visit to their last. If you thrive on connecting with people and genuinely care about their experience, this role was built for you.

**What You'll Do:**

*Create an Outstanding Client Experience*

* Greet every client warmly and make them feel at home from the moment they arrive
* Build real relationships with clients over the course of their care, learning their goals, their sports, and what matters to them
* Answer calls, texts, and emails with warmth, patience, and professionalism
* Help new clients feel confident and informed about what to expect before, during, and after their visits
* Guide clients through next steps after evaluations, including scheduling their plan of care and understanding their options
* Handle questions, concerns, and schedule changes with empathy and a problem\-solving attitude
* Follow up with clients who've missed visits or paused care, checking in with genuine care rather than a script

*Keep the Client Journey Running Smoothly*

* Manage scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellations so clients get the times that work for them
* Process payments and explain billing, packages, and Superbills clearly and comfortably
* Keep the front desk and lobby organized, welcoming, and ready for every client
* Protect client privacy and handle all health information with care and confidentiality
* Partner with our clinicians and Operations Manager to make sure every client's experience is seamless

**This Role Is Right for You If:**

* You light up when you're helping people and get energy from conversation
* You've worked in hospitality, retail, fitness, a spa, a salon, a hotel, or any role where the customer experience came first
* You stay calm, kind, and positive, even when things get busy
* You're a natural communicator who can explain things clearly and make people feel heard
* You follow through on what you promise and take pride in being dependable
* You're comfortable learning new software (we'll train you on our systems)
* You love the idea of being part of a small, close\-knit team where your personality makes a difference
* Bonus points if you're into sports, fitness, running, or an active lifestyle

**About Competitive Edge Physical Therapy:**


Competitive Edge Physical Therapy helps active adults and athletes throughout the Bay Area move better, perform better, and stay active for life. With locations in San Jose, Santa Clara, Pleasanton, and Fremont, we pair advanced biomechanics technology with truly high\-touch, personal care. Our clients aren't patients to us. They're people with goals, and we treat them that way from the first phone call.


We're a privately owned, growing company with high standards and a strong, supportive culture. Here, you won't be a number in a large system. You'll see the direct impact you have on clients every single day, your ideas will be heard, and strong performers are trusted to grow with us as we expand.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* $22–$25/hour based on experience
* $200 monthly medical stipend (full\-time)
* 2 weeks paid vacation plus the week between Christmas and New Year's
* 401k with 4% company match
* Paid sick time
* Weekly professional development

**One Small Application Detail (Read Carefully)**  

When you apply, please include the word "welcome" somewhere in your cover letter, and tell us about a time you made someone's day better.

jobs.description:
Denali Therapeutics Inc. is a biotechnology company pioneering a new class of biotherapeutics designed to cross the blood\-brain barrier (BBB) using its proprietary TransportVehicle™ platform. With the first FDA\-approved biologic specifically designed to cross the BBB, a clinically validated delivery platform and a growing portfolio of therapeutic candidates across all stages of development, we are advancing toward our goal of delivering effective medicines to transform the lives of people living with neurodegenerative diseases, lysosomal storage disorders and other serious diseases.  



  

We invite you to consider an opportunity with Denali to help achieve our goal of delivering meaningful therapeutics to patients.

  

  

This individual will guide efforts to increase productivity through innovative solutions, support and/or manage the BSO systems and tools within the Biorepository and Clinical Study Management teams and is responsible for the integrity of Denali's valuable clinical biospecimen collection, and associated data, to enable Denali's goals. This is achieved through oversight of BSO staff, hands\-on work, collaboration with other functions and continuous improvement of BSO procedures and practices.
**Key Accountabilities / Core Job Responsibilities**

* Management of software containing clinical biospecimen data in close collaboration with Biorepository staff, Clinical Study Management, Data Management and Clinical Programming
* Responsible for ongoing maintenance and improvements of BSO systems and tools, as necessary
* Ensure sample integrity and maintain GCP and GDPR compliance for clinical trial samples through chain of custody, sample handling guidelines, and proper storage conditions
* Responsible for design and build of study collection plans to allow real\-time import of incoming samples into LIMS. This requires coordination with scientists, CROs and vendors and ability to interpret clinical research protocols.
* Responsible for vendor management and oversight of BSO managed vendors
* Mentor and train BSO staff, train relevant functional groups in BSO procedures, and participate in the creation and updating of BSO SOPs
* Management of biomarker studies and collaborations, and support of clinical study management projects
* Lead process improvement projects to enable efficiency and innovation in BSO processes
* Review and approve Data Transfer Specifications, custom manifests, import files, and other sample data collection documents

**Qualifications/Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biology, Immunology, Medical Technology or related field, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in Translational Medicine or Clinical Development, or related field/training
* Experience with human biosample management, regulatory compliance, and quality assurance in a clinical trials/drug\-development setting
* Proficient in LIMS database entry, advanced Excel, and interpreting Clinical Research Protocols
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional team matrix environment
* Strong customer\-service focus with advanced planning and organizational skills; adapts quickly to shifting priorities and deadlines

Salary Range: $114,000\.00 to $149,000\.00 . Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. This compensation and benefits information is based on Denali’s good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Tech Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Bizzaly**

Bizzaly helps small businesses make technology and AI work for them, without the jargon. Our clients include local small businesses across the Bay Area. Many are experienced professionals who are great at their work but overwhelmed by software, subscriptions, and the pace of change in AI. We assess their technology, recommend the right tools, and set everything up so it simply works.

**The role** We're looking for a patient, practical tech professional to handle the hands\-on side of our client work. Our team runs client relationships, business analysis, and training. You'll be the person who makes the recommended changes happen. This is a flexible, project\-based role with room to grow as Bizzaly grows.

**What you'll do**

* Set up and configure business tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, password managers, cloud storage, and backups
* Migrate email, files, and accounts from old systems to new ones
* Connect business apps so they share information (accounting, project management, scheduling, CRM)
* Set up AI tools and help configure simple automations
* Walk clients through their new setup in plain, friendly language
* Document what you set up so our team and clients can refer back to it
* Flag anything outside our scope, such as networks, servers, or hardware, so we can refer it to a partner

**What we're looking for**

* 3\+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or small\-business technology setup
* Hands\-on experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration
* Strong security habits, including careful handling of client access and data
* Willingness to learn about new software and tools that small businesses use
* Patience and warmth with non\-technical people. This matters as much as technical skill.
* Reliability and clear communication about timelines
* Ability to travel to client offices in the South Bay occasionally

**Nice to have**

* Experience with small\-business software such as QuickBooks, Gusto, or industry tools (Revit, Bluebeam, real estate CRMs, construction software)
* Experience with automation tools like Zapier or Make
* Comfort using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT

**Why work with us**

* Flexible schedule that fits around other work, retirement, or family
* Meaningful work helping local business owners
* A small, supportive team where your input shapes how we work
* Opportunity to grow into a larger role

Pay: From $40\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sunnyvale, CA 94087

* Serve as a subject matter expert representative for Information Integrity efforts, in coordination with Regional Policy, Public Policy, Comms, and/or Outreach \& Partnerships.

We believe in career development and empowering our employees. Not only do we provide career coaches internally, but we offer many training opportunities to expand your knowledge base! We have tuition reimbursement, leadership development, and even start employees off with 16 days of paid time off plus holidays. **NeoGenomics has an opening for a Senior Training Program Specialist, Commercial Education \& Effectiveness who wants to continue to learn in order to allow our company to grow. The ideal candidate will be located Remote Non\-CA with travel to Fort Myers for a week every other month.**

**Now that you know what we're looking for in talent, let us tell you why you'd want to work at NeoGenomics:**

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Senior Training Program Specialist owns the operational backbone of the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness (CEE) training calendar. The role plans and runs the logistics for approximately five new hire training classes per year, each built as a virtual week followed by a week\-long in\-person program, and partners with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session. The Specialist schedules and confirms presenters, manages hotel and program logistics, prepares materials, administers the learning platform and the CEE SharePoint site, and maintains attendance, completion, and evaluation records.


This is a program and project management role. The Specialist is the single point of accountability for ensuring programs run on time, on budget, and without disruption to learning.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end logistics plan and timeline for approximately five new hire training classes per year, working backward from each class start date across both the virtual and in\-person portions of the program.
* Schedule and confirm presenters for virtual training sessions, including invitations, calendar management, content collection, quality review, and same\-day support.
* Manage hotel, venue, and participant travel logistics for week\-long in\-person programs, including room blocks, meeting space, audiovisual requirements, food and beverage coordination, and accessibility needs.
* Partner with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session, owning the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness training workstream.
* Serve as the onsite point of contact during training programs, managing materials, shipping, badges, signage, room setup, and agenda changes.
* Track and reconcile program spend against budget, including vendor contracts, hotel invoices, purchase orders, and cost summaries.
* Build and maintain the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness SharePoint site, including document libraries, permissions, metadata, version control, and naming conventions.
* Audit and retire sales training content on a scheduled basis and coordinate required internal reviews for clinical, marketing, and claims\-related materials.
* Administer the learning platform, including curricula, enrollments, assignment rules, reporting, and learner record migration activities.
* Maintain accurate attendance, completion, assessment, and evaluation records and create post\-program reports.
* Utilize Microsoft Office and other digital tools to organize, track, and report training activities.
* Coordinate and facilitate communication within the commercial organization regarding training events, schedules, and updates.
* Support onboarding for new sales and support team members by ensuring system access and training resources are available before day one.
* Administer post\-training surveys and 60\- and 90\-day follow\-up assessments and summarize findings.
* Prepare manager touchpoint materials, including pre\-class briefing packets and post\-class coaching guides.
* Provide administrative support to the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness team and perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience, Education and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Five or more years of experience in program or project coordination, corporate meeting and event planning, training coordination, or a sales or support role.
* Experience in a diagnostic laboratory, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare environment preferred.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a cross\-functional environment.
* Experience coordinating multi\-day, multi\-presenter meetings or training programs, including registrations, room blocks, banquet event orders, and vendor invoicing.
* Strong professional verbal and written communication skills and a customer\-focused approach.
* Demonstrated SharePoint proficiency, including document libraries, permissions, metadata management, and version control.
* Ability to effectively follow up with senior leaders and subject matter experts to secure commitments, presentations, and approvals on schedule.
* Learning management system administration experience preferred.

This is a player\-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high\-availability, multi\-platform networks.


You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost\-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.


The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

**Position Details:**

**Reports to:** President

**Direct reports:** Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

**Location:** Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

**Travel:** Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

**Schedule:** Monday \- Friday 8:00\-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on\-call rotation.

**Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K \+ employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

### **Proactive Client Improvement**

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost\-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end\-of\-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

### **Leadership**

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1\-on\-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To\-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross\-functional or cross\-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on\-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after\-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

### **Operations and Compliance**

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

### **Education and Work Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10\+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3\+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex netw

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Firefox Enterprise
jobs.description:
**Why Mozilla?**



Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**About this team and role:**



Firefox Enterprise is a new team within Mozilla that is addressing the needs of business and government customers for a secure enterprise browser that gives organizations greater control over their data, policies, and digital infrastructure. We’re now seeking a **Strategic Account Manager, Firefox Enterprise** to help grow Firefox Enterprise in **France**. This is a high\-impact enterprise sales role for someone who is excited to build deep relationships with customers and help them achieve success using Firefox Enterprise.


**What you’ll do:**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term client relationships
* Understand our customer goals, challenges, and business needs
* Drive Firefox Enterprise adoption, engagement, and overall satisfaction across the account
* Manage renewals and proactively address retention risks
* Coordinate with internal teams (Sales, Support, Product, Solution Engineering) to deliver a seamless customer experience
* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including additional seats, upgraded tiers, or new use cases
* Track account health, usage, and performance metrics, including forecast reports on retention, renewal and expansion
* Conduct regular check\-ins, business reviews, and success planning with customers
* Resolve issues and escalate when necessary to ensure timely resolution


**What you’ll bring:**


* Significant experience in enterprise SaaS, infrastructure, security, or platform account management, sales, customer support or other customer facing roles
* Strong relationship\-building skills with the ability to establish trust and credibility at all levels of a customer organization
* Proven track record of supporting customer renewals, retention, and revenue growth
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French.
* Must be willing and able to travel within France as needed for the role, with a preference for candidates located in the Paris metro area
* Must be willing and able to occasionally accommodate collaboration and meetings aligned with U.S. business hours
* Negotiation and influence skills to support renewals, expansions, and customer advocacy
* Commitment to our values:
* + Welcoming differences
	+ Being relationship\-minded
	+ Practicing responsible participation
	+ Having grit

**What you’ll get:**


* Generous performance\-based bonus plans to all eligible employees \- we share in our success as one team
* Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
* Quarterly all\-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
* Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
* One\-time home office stipend
* Annual professional development budget
* Quarterly well\-being stipend
* Considerable paid parental leave
* Employee referral bonus program
* Other benefits (life/AD\&D, disability, EAP, etc. \- varies by country)


**About Mozilla**



Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.


**Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**



Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity\-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.



We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior,

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Broadcast Media
jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.
  
The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.
  
  

**Location:** Preferred Northeast or Southeast
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to Media and Entertainment’s consulting projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, internal and external consultants and subject matter experts, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members. Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Coordinates all deliverable documentation between all internal and external stakeholders. Facilitates and directs document reviews to assure proper documentation is delivered to the client. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates transition of projects to later phase project teams.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence, and people management skills. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.


**Physical Demands:**  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee. The employee will experience normal office conditions and be required to use office equipment such as computers, peripherals, etc.
  
  

**Travel:**  

Some travel by car and occasional airplane trips should be expected as much of our consulting work is conducted remotely with occasional in person meetings. Employee must possess a valid driver’s license in their state of residence. Employee will be required to use their own vehicle and will be reimbursed for mileage at the current corporate rate. 10% remote travel is not unusual.
  
  

**Safety:**  

When meeting a client in person, Diversified requires SPMs t

jobs.title: Patient Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Skylark Sleep**

Skylark Sleep is a nationwide virtual sleep medicine practice delivering high\-quality, guideline\-based care for obstructive sleep apnea, insomnia, and related sleep disorders across all 50 states. We combine board\-certified sleep physicians, home sleep testing, oral appliance and PAP therapy management, and remote patient monitoring to make expert sleep care convenient and accessible. As we scale, we are building an operations team obsessed with a seamless, high\-touch patient experience from first contact through long\-term therapy.

**Position Summary**

The Patient Success Manager is a central member of the clinical operations team, working closely with and in direct support of the Clinic Operations Director. This role owns the day\-to\-day patient\-facing and behind\-the\-scenes coordination that keeps a virtual sleep clinic running smoothly: guiding patients through intake and onboarding, coordinating home sleep testing and therapy devices, managing scheduling and insurance workflows, and serving as a reliable point of contact throughout each patient's care journey. The ideal candidate is highly organized, service\-oriented, comfortable in a fast\-moving remote environment, and experienced in clinic operations.

**Patient Intake \& Onboarding**

* Be the welcoming, knowledgeable first point of contact who sets the tone for the patient experience.
* Guide new patients through registration, insurance verification, consent, and intake questionnaires, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate before their first visit.
* Verify insurance eligibility and benefits, obtain prior authorizations as needed, and partner with the billing/revenue cycle team to support clean documentation and timely claims.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records within the EHR system.

**Scheduling \& Care Coordination**

* Coordinate the shipment, tracking, and return of home sleep apnea testing (HSAT) devices, and support patients with setup and troubleshooting to ensure successful test completion.
* Coordinate PAP and oral appliance therapy logistics with clinical staff, DME suppliers, and dental partners.
* Schedule and manage telehealth visits, follow\-up appointments, and device fittings across multiple time zones.
* Act as a liaison between patients, clinicians, DME providers, and external partners to keep care moving without gaps, and proactively follow up to support therapy adherence and reduce no\-shows.
* Support enrollment and ongoing engagement in remote patient monitoring (RPM) and chronic care management programs, escalating clinical concerns as needed.

**Process \& Operations Support**

* Assist the Clinic Operations Director in refining intake workflows, standard operating procedures, and patient communication templates.
* Identify recurring friction points in the patient journey and recommend improvements.
* Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA and all applicable privacy, documentation, and telehealth standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a clinic operations or healthcare administrative environment.
* Demonstrated proficiency with electronic health record (EHR) systems and standard office/productivity software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm, patient\-centered approach.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Comfort working in a remote, technology\-driven environment and adapting to new tools and workflows.
* Reliable high\-speed internet and a private, HIPAA\-appropriate remote workspace.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with medical clinic billing, insurance verification, or prior authorization (strongly preferred).
* Background in sleep medicine, telehealth, DME, or remote patient monitoring.
* Experience supporting a multi\-state or virtual clinical practice.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive hourly compensation ($26\.00 – $28\.00/hour).
* Fully remote work environment.
* The opportunity to help build a patient experience from the ground up at a fast\-growing, mission\-driven sleep medicine company.
* A collaborative team that values initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement.

*Skylark Sleep is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

Pay: $25\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Healthcare management: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: IRB Operations Specialist 1 (Remote)
jobs.description:
**About WCG**
-------------



WCG delivers transformational solutions that accelerate clinical research and advance human health. We serve the experts, innovators, and pathfinders on the frontlines of science and medicine—empowering them to develop breakthrough therapies while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials.
**Why WCG**
-----------



At WCG, we invest in our people because you are the driving force behind our mission. When you grow, our impact grows. When you thrive, research accelerates. We empower you to build a meaningful career while advancing the work that improves lives.  

What we offer:
Comprehensive health and financial protection – Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accounts
  

Resources that support your whole life – Employee assistance programs and work/life balance tools
  

Investment in your growth – Referral bonuses, tuition reimbursement, on\-the\-job training, certification assistance, and continuing education support
  

Time to recharge – Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time
  

Pathways forward – Career development opportunities across One WCG
We practice transparency in everything we do, including compensation. The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission.
**Job Summary**
---------------


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to supporting data collection, the management
and analysis of documents, client reporting and problem resolution. This position will:
* Support the Board and clients by preparing documents for review in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements
* Provide accurate document identification and data entry
* Finalize and deliver documents to clients
* Meet assigned metrics around speed and accuracy
* Able to deal effectively with high work volume, rigid deadlines, and frequent changes
Specific job function requirements are outlined on training curriculum and addenda that supports step level 1 development in this position. Each function is made up of multiple duties. Specific criteria have been attributed to each duty to measure proficiency. As proficiency is proven in each duty, additional duties will be assigned for learning.
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.
* Ability to maintain and promote positive working relationships with clients (internal and external) by providing timely and professional service to their needs within the scope of company mission and accompanying regulations
* Maintain close attention to detail
* Ability to proof\-read and detect errors in typing, spelling, grammar, syntax, and punctuation
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as protocols for clinical investigations, medical, literature, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions
* Ability to set priorities and manage time effectively
* Accurately and completely enter information in a database system
* Contribute to a positive team environment through collaborative engagement with others
* Resolve questions and problems effectively
* Communicate to obtain information or clarify requests
* Mentor team members by teaching procedures, monitoring, and proofing work, and providing constructive feedback as needed or requested
* Is able to assist others across Operations, as needed. This may include overtime requests, training support, etc.
* Professional/oral written communication skills
* Independent worker

jobs.title: Operations Manager II - Referral Management & Analytics - South Region
jobs.description:
**Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** has an exciting career opportunity available as an **Operations Manager II for the Referral Management \& Analytics** **Service Line**. This position will over see the Southern Region.
This role operates within the Referral Management \& Analytics service line and requires demonstrated experience leading operations in a high\-volume, physician\-referral\-driven healthcare environment. The ideal candidate will have experience managing distinct teams focused on both referral coordination and outreach, and data\-driven analytics used to identify volume trends, at\-risk referral sources, and growth opportunities. This role requires deep expertise in navigating physician office relationships, referral workflow and EMR/ordering systems, and the reporting frameworks needed to translate referral data into actionable retention and growth strategies.
This role serves as the face of Elevate PFS to our hospital clients on a day to day basis. The purpose of this position is to lead and manage all operational staff and client portfolios encompassing the assigned area within the division of the applicable service line(s). Ownership of staff and associate procedures, clients and associated relationships, and revenue and cost functions is crucial.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
* Responsible for day to day operations of staff and client needs.
* Manage and orient staff; assigns work, develops work schedules, instructs in proper procedures; assists with development and revision of department processes/procedures.
* Monitor staff performance, provides employee recognition and feedback.
* Address and resolve personnel issues in a timely and effective manner.
* Document issues and concerns to their upline leader(s).
* Work collaboratively with upline leadership to establish staff goals.
* Oversee the performance appraisal process to support performance and development.
* Monitor overall project performance and provides monthly analysis of certification performance; reports findings and implements solutions when negative trends are noted.
* Monitor billing procedures and documentation and provides updates with regulatory compliance; conducts periodic audits; and maintains files.
* Develop relationships with clients and county agencies.
* When necessary, partner with Client Services to discuss and address client concerns/issues immediately as they arise.
* Ensure all communication from patients and providers have timely follow\-up and resolution of complaints and concerns.
* Provide adequate training needs to the staff related to policies/procedures or government regulations.
* Represent Elevate PFS at client department meetings.
* Develop and implement effective communication channels to provide information to all staff members.
* Work collaboratively with other facets of the operations which includes Disability, AR Services, Early Out, IT and HR.
* Lead succession planning efforts to ensure organizational continuity.
* Execute strategic initiatives aligned with Company goals.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications and Requirements**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities.
* High School Diploma or GED; Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Minimum of 2 years of management experience, managing at least 5 people
* Hospital revenue cycle experience preferred
* Familiarization with state and federal programs
* Strong leadership and communication skills, high service orientation and strong computer system and analytical skills are required.
* Excellent time management skills
* Accustomed to working in a rapidly changing environment
* Experience with Hospital systems such as STAR, EPIC, Cerner, Meditech, etc.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn computer applications
* Knowledge of HIPAA, ACA and EMTALA regulations
* Excellent communication skills both written and oral
* Remote and Hybrid positions require home internet connections that meet the Company’s upload and download speed criteria.


**Benefits**  

ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees –the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well\-being of our employees and their families.
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* 401K (100% match for the first 3% \& 50% match for the next 2%)
* 15 days of PTO
* 7 paid Holidays
* 2 Floating holidays
* 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday)
* Pet Insurance
* Employee referral bonus program
* Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together
* Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles

The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.

jobs.description:
**About the job**

**Title:** Senior Operations Project Manager

**Industry:** Power Distribution / Electrification / Critical Infrastructure Equipment

**Segments:** Data Centers, Hyperscalers, Utilities, Power Generation

**Location:** Remote (U.S.) \| Travel as Needed (up to 25%)

**Compensation:** Competitive Base Salary \+ Performance Bonus\[KK1]

**Reporting Manager:** Director, Project Management

**About PDM**

PDM is one of the fastest growing manufacturers in the electrical power industry. PDM delivers mission\-critical, utility\-grade products across industry sectors powering the modern world, including **HV/MV/LV transformers,** **circuit breakers, gas\-insulated switchgear, and other transmission\-grade equipment** to a global portfolio of customers. PDM’s essential solutions support the backbone of **data centers, AI hyperscalers, utilities infrastructure, power generation, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, and the oil \& gas infrastructure**. With explosive growth in AI and demand for power, this is a career\-defining opportunity to contribute to a growing global market with long\-term momentum.

**Position Overview**

We are hiring a Senior Operations Project Manager to bridge the gap between customers, commissioning teams, design engineers, factory operations, and field service partners. As the Senior Operations Project Manager, you will support the sales team in facilitating customer solutions and lead the execution of complex electrical distribution projects for data centers, hyperscalers, oil \& gas, clean power, and other industrial clients.

This is a customer\-facing operations role where you will execute timelines, track and communicate progress using project management methodologies, identify and mitigate risks, coordinate startup and after\-sales services, manage project budgets, and maintain project stakeholder alignment throughout the equipment lifecycle. Ideal for someone who is process driven and thrives on clarity, communication, and fast\-moving infrastructure environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.


At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.


This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------



Leads the systems, governance, planning, and insights that enable the creative organization to operate effectively at scale. Owns intake, prioritization, capacity and resource planning, workflow governance, reporting, process design, and operational health. Partners with creative leadership to align resources with business priorities, improve how work moves through the organization, and build scalable practices that increase speed, visibility, accountability, and creative impact. Transforms reactive request management into a transparent, strategic, and scalable operating model.

**The Main Responsibilities**

* Own enterprise creative intake and set briefing, categorization, prioritization, and readiness standards so requests arrive with sufficient context, scope, and strategic clarity.
* Define pathways for planned, reactive, executive, innovation, and special\-initiative work; assess readiness, close information gaps, and improve submission quality before scoping or assignment.
* Maintain visibility into capacity, workload, utilization, project mix, skill demand, and constraints across internal teams and external partners; forecast needs using pipeline, priorities, seasonality, campaign calendars, and enterprise initiatives.
* Identify staffing gaps, bottlenecks, and over\-allocation risks before delivery is affected, informing staffing, contractor, agency, and headcount decisions.

* Facilitate tradeoffs across campaigns, executive and reactive requests, brand initiatives, and capability\-building work; guide decisions to start, pause, accelerate, outsource, or decline work and align resources to highest\-impact priorities.
* Own the operating model from intake and scoping through assignment, production, review, approval, delivery, and measurement; define stages, roles, decision rights, handoffs, review cycles, escalation paths, and governance standards.
* Drive consistent use of work\-management tools, intake systems, dashboards, and processes while clarifying requirements and reducing friction across creative teams, stakeholders, agencies, PMO, and partner functions.
* Build dashboards and reporting on demand, project mix, throughput, cycle time, workload, utilization, velocity, and bottlenecks, giving leaders clear visibility into capacity, operating health, and tradeoffs.
* Track trends and define KPIs linking operations to creative effectiveness and business impact, using insights to guide staffing, partner strategy, prioritization, process improvement, speed, quality, clarity, and scale.
* Design, document, and improve workflows, SOPs, governance, briefs, review practices, and operating cadences; remove redundant work, unclear ownership, unnecessary approvals, and process gaps.

* Configure tools to support the operating model and provide team and leadership visibility; identify opportunities for automation, templates, improved reporting, and workflow simplification.
* Partner with technology and operations teams to improve adoption, data quality, and system effectiveness, and set standards for tracking work, resources, timelines, and project metadata.
* Advise creative leadership on structure, resource planning, workload forecasts, agency and contractor strategy, future operating models, business cases, staffing recommendations, and capability planning.
* Identify recurring demand patterns requiring new roles, process or scope changes, or alternative partner models, and clarify how organizational design choices affect capacity, velocity, quality, and business impact.
**What We Look For in a Candidate**

* 7\+ years in creative or marketing operations, PMO, resource management, agency operations, or related operational leadership.

They drive successful engagements through negotiation, concise communication, crucial conversations, and leadership abilities.  



  

**What you will do:**

  

* Use experience, skillset, and methodologies to understand the client’s end goals and provide a consultative approach to ensure that the solution provided is appropriate for the client’s desired overall outcome and strategy.
* Be a trusted consultant to your project team in all matters related to project delivery, CDW processes, and project management with best practices and delivery. Build relationships with all project stakeholders.
* Creates and maintains presence with all project stakeholders, acting as a CDW steward for quality. Dedicated to meeting or exceeding stakeholder expectations. Identifies success criteria and ensures that it is met by involving the stakeholders in key decisions and linking project outcomes to strategic business initiatives.
* Recognizes the need for negotiations, gathers relevant information, and seeks advice from sales and management when needed. Negotiates changes (cost, scope, effort, schedule of solution, resource commitment, etc.) to agreeable results. Effective negotiation of changes that achieve stakeholder satisfaction and drive positive project results.
* Works with team members to gather information and determine impacts to the project, document mitigation steps taken in troubleshooting, and communicate these to the team and client.
* Independently manages medium to large sized projects requiring complex cross functional collaboration and management, adhering to CDW’s project management processes and methodologies.
* Accountable for project profitability. Track project budgets and resources and manage actuals vs. planned hours against the resource allocation and budget. Timely reporting of project financials and budgets to stakeholders. Ties project outcomes to clients’ business strategies, helping to generate new business.
* Ensures that time, expenses, and invoices are accurately tracked and approved against the project in a timely manner.
* Validates initial project scope and estimates. Determine the need for a new Statement of Work versus a Change Order. Makes sellers aware of new opportunities for additional services opportunities uncovered during project delivery.
* Ensures all items defined in CDW Statement of Work are delivered and perform quality assurance throughout the lifecycle of the project.
* Establishes, monitors, adjusts and communicates tasks and associated schedules to the project team and modifies when necessary. Build project schedules in conjunction with our engineering teams and partner resources.
* Aids in identifying proper resources and optimizing billable schedules, monitors and adjusts assignments as necessary to drive client satisfaction and project profitability.
* Identify, documents, tracks, and communicate project risks and issues. Strategizes potential resolution and drives desired course of action to bring issues to timely resolution.
* Manages equipment, software, licensing and outside services procurement and delivery schedules.
* Documents, outcomes, lessons learned and shared appropriately with colleagues. Leverage expertise to help drive business process improvements within the CDW Services PMO.

* Leads teams to consistently meet project success factors and exceed client expectations.
* Inspects delegated tasks to ensure timely and accurate completion. Coach and mentor Associate Project Managers.
* Stays abreast of industry best practices through research, conferences, training seminars and participation in professional associations. Shares information across the Services PMO.
