jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description :

As an Implementation Manager at Enlyte, you will leverage a blend of technical expertise, project coordination, and client\-facing skills to lead the development, implementation, and testing of integration solutions supporting Mitchell products and services. In this role, you will collaborate across multiple teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet client needs and project timelines.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Evaluate Statements of Work and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to assess project requirements, methodologies, and deliverables.
* Design, configure, deploy, and validate Mitchell products and services, including integration infrastructure components.
* Create and maintain detailed requirements, design, deployment, support, and project documentation.
* Support project tracking, reporting, and coordination activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide direct client support during the post\-go\-live stabilization period.
* Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's Degree in a computer related field or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 3 years of experience with several of the following technologies:
	+ FTP/SFTP
	+ Web Services
	+ XML
	+ PGP
	+ Microsoft SQL server query writing
	+ JavaScript programming
	+ Microsoft Windows client / server operating systems
	+ Amazon Workspace
	+ Amazon Cloud Technologies
* Demonstrated experience and success in the following areas:
	+ Proven success collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
	+ Strong technical analysis, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
	+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
	+ Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
* Experience in medical bill review, healthcare technology, claims management, or a related industry is preferred.
* Experience working in a technical support, implementation, systems integration, or client\-facing technology role is preferred.


Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $95,000 \- $110,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.  

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

  

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Job Title: Project Manager, National Technical Assistance and Coordination Center



Location: Bethesda, Maryland (Remote)



Reports To: Director, Technical Assistance Implementation and Partnerships



FLSA Status: Exempt



Must be able to provide proof of residence in one of these states: KS, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, TN, TX, PA, VA, WA, WV, and DC



\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_


#### **About NACHC:**


Founded in 1971, the National Association of Community Health Centers (NACHC) serves as the leading voice for America’s Health Centers and the people and communities they serve. NACHC works to promote the provision of high\-quality, affordable, community\-based health care to everyone, particularly to underserved populations.



\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_


#### **Position Summary:**


Responsible for project management and implementation activities related to the National Technical Assistance Program Cooperative Agreement. This position requires technical oversight and quality assurance. Working in close coordination and collaboration with the supervisor, this position will ensure that relevant projects meet the compliance and reporting standards required by federal funders, as well as additional needs of internal teams and external partners.



\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_


#### **Key Responsibilities:**


1\) Strategic Implementation: Responsible for overall effective project management and execution of NACHC’s National TA Program (NTAP) Cooperative Agreement in coordination with supervisor.

* Develop and/or support systems to manage projects that include clear workflows, automation, and reporting dashboards, ensuring that the approach aligns with NACHC’s overall project management approach/systems.
* Develop, maintain, and evaluate standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure clarity, efficiency, and compliance for internal team members.
* Identify opportunities for improvement of existing functionality, troubleshooting, and collaborate with other project managers (as applicable) to develop training materials for staff on how to use project management tools and other applicable systems/trackers.
* Set implementation priorities and provide communication and coordination with internal teams and external partners including the federal funder.
* Track project, grant, funder, and other deliverables/progress as applicable.
* Identify when/if a project or deliverable is off track and alert relevant team members, partners, and funders.
* Review and analyze project data to ensure the accuracy of information.
* Report on status, milestones, deliverables, outcomes, and lessons learned to all applicable parties both in written form and verbally as needed.
* Use analytical tools to track outcomes.


2\) Technical Oversight and Quality Assurance: Monitor and ensure compliance with federal program goals and requirements consistent with federal oversight

* Guide the daily execution of the National TA Program Cooperative Agreement ensuring alignment with funder and NACHC requirements.
* Ensure programs adhere to federal policies, HRSA standards, and other local, state, and federal regulations as applicable.
* Oversee endtoend review and clearance process for technical assistance (TA) resources and presentation materials, including internal quality assurance reviews, coordination and tracking of HRSA review and approval, and final dissemination, posting, or delivery of approved materials.
* Develop, maintain and oversee internal quality review process for all NTAPfunded TA products, resources, and presentations.
* Ensures NACHC NTAP website is updated with all cleared TA resources and events.
* In close coordination with supervisor, provide oversight for the Health Center Resource Clearinghouse contract and tracks timely execution of deliverables.


3\) Business Operations and Financial Stewardship: Oversee assigned project budgets, manage funding cycles, and ensure that all fiscal operations comply with funding requirements in collaboration with supervisor and other internal teams and the federal funder, when applicable.

* Track spenddown, conduct financial reviews and programmatic audits, identify risks, and recommend actions to supervisor.
* Analyze and interpret funder requirements and NACHC policies to develop, update, and execute Standard Operating Procedures.
* Analyze and measure the effectiveness of existing processes and develop sustainable, repeatable, and quantifiable process improvements.
* Provide supervision to external consultants as applicable.


4\) Cross\-Functional Coordination: Build internal and external relationships, and ensure coordination

* Coordinate project management approaches with NACHC colleagues to ensure enterprisewide coordination.
* Work closely within HCOG and with other functional areas to track project execution and ensure adherence to program requirements.
* Lead or participate in crossfunctional project teams, assign tasks, and track progress through project completion as applicable.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with NACHC internal teams and external partners including funders.


5\) Procurement: Support Procurement RFP, RFI, and Other Procurement Processes

* Coordinate with HCOG Business Operations team, supervisor, and other internal team members to determine specific procurement needs.
* Maintain standards, best practices, and templates required to assist SMEs in creating RFPs, RFIs, and/or other procurement processes (e.g., mentors, discussion leaders, etc.).
* Follow organizational and programspecific procedures for reviewing RFPs/RFIs/other procurement, properly organize and maintain vendor records, review materials, and scoring guidance under established best practices and internal policies.


6\) Organizational Collaboration: Contribute to NACHC’s overall programming

**Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC)** is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions that provide reliable power and modernize infrastructure. Since 2000, we have served as a trusted partner to public and private sector customers across North America, the UK and Europe, delivering over **$15 billion in solutions** and contracting more than **5 GW of energy resources**.

Join us in building the infrastructure that powers the future. Explore opportunities to make a meaningful impact while growing your career with a company at the forefront of energy innovation.

  

Ameresco has an immediate opening for a **Project Manager – Facility Condition Assessments \& Capital Planning**. The Project Manager is responsible for leading Facility Condition Assessment (FCA), asset management, and capital planning projects for primarily Municipal, University, School District, and Healthcare (MUSH) clients. This role oversees the successful delivery of projects from initiation through completion, ensuring that scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations are consistently achieved.

  

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for clients and coordinates multidisciplinary teams responsible for facility assessments, asset inventories, capital planning analyses, data management, reporting, and software implementation activities. The position requires strong project leadership, technical knowledge of building systems, and the ability to translate facility data into actionable capital planning strategies. * Review facility condition indices (FCI), renewal forecasts, and capital planning recommendations.
* Ensure consistency and accuracy of asset inventories and condition data.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts in architecture, engineering, energy, and asset management disciplines.

### **Data \& Capital Planning Management**

* Oversee data collection, validation, and integration into capital planning platforms.
* Guide development of short\-term and long\-term capital improvement plans.
* Support lifecycle modeling, asset renewal forecasting, and funding scenario analyses.

### **Team Coordination**

* Lead multidisciplinary project teams, including assessors, engineers, architects, and data analysts.

* Mentor junior staff and support professional development.

### **Quality Assurance**

* Ensure deliverables meet company standards and client expectations.
* Conduct quality reviews of assessment data, reports, and capital planning recommendations.
* Verify that project documentation is complete, accurate, and defensible.
* Support continuous improvement of assessment methodologies and project delivery processes.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, Asset Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of project management experience in facility assessments, capital planning, asset management, engineering consulting, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience managing client\-facing projects.

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience working with K\-12, higher education, healthcare, municipal, or public\-sector clients.
* Strong knowledge of building systems, facility infrastructure, deferred maintenance, and capital renewal planning.
* Experience developing and managing project schedules and budgets.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

* Knowledge of FCA methodologies, FCI calculations, and lifecycle modeling practices.

* Professional Engineering (PE), Registered Architect (RA), Certified Facility Manager (CFM), or related professional credential.

**Project Manager Data Management and Artificial Intelligence (Remote)**


Rothe is seeking a Project Manager specializing in Data Management and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to provide remote project management support for the Chief Data and Artificial Intelligence Office in support of the NASA Enterprise Multimedia and Integrated Technical Services (eMITS) contract. eMITS is the Agency’s enterprise\-level contract creating and delivering multimedia and technical communications through the use of the internet, digital platforms, and IT management for NASA’s Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and Office of Communications (OCOMM). From photographing rocket launches and recoveries, to producing engaging videos, to information technology management, to using social media to share NASA’s message, eMITS integrates services for NASA IT and provides NASA’s communication to the outside world. Come join us in support of NASA’s mission to inspire the world through information and discovery.


**Job Description:**


Provide comprehensive programmatic, strategic, and technical support to the Chief Data Officer (CDO), Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO), and broader CDAIO teams. The role spans policy development, governance, data/AI strategy execution, workforce training, and multi\-center coordination to advance NASA’s Data Strategy and AI maturity.


**Functional Responsibilities:**


Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


Policy, Governance, and Compliance


* Lead development, coordination, and implementation of data and AI policies, including governance standards, metadata and classification frameworks, interoperability models, and compliance enforcement mechanisms.
* Conduct policy gap assessments, manage exception processes, monitor compliance, and support consensus\-building across NASA centers and external partners.


AI and Data Risk Management


* Develop and maintain AI risk assessment methodologies aligned with NIST AI RMF, including bias testing, safety validation, and ongoing performance monitoring for deployed models.
* Identify risks, create risk statements, mitigation plans, and impact analyses.


Strategic Planning \& Inter\-Organizational Coordination


* Facilitate inter\-organizational planning and coordination to meet federal requirements and support NASA’s Data Strategy, Data Action Plan goals, and enterprise milestones.
* Provide project and program management support aligned with IT, data, and AI domain knowledge, applying cost/schedule/performance metrics.


Training, Workforce Development \& Media Support


* Develop and coordinate training materials, briefings, and workforce development strategies to improve NASA\-wide proficiency in AI and data competencies.

jobs.title: Drinking Water Project Manager | Ownership Opportunity
jobs.description:
Woodard \& Curran is an employee\-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet. **What's in It for You?**  

**Lead impactful drinking water projects while building your ownership legacy.**  


Woodard \& Curran is seeking a dynamic, detail\-oriented, and client\-focused Drinking Water Project Manager to join our growing Water Team. This is an exciting opportunity for a licensed Professional Engineer with drinking water infrastructure experience who is passionate about delivering meaningful projects, building strong client relationships, and helping communities solve complex water challenges.  


We are primarily seeking candidates located in Florida, where you will support the continued growth of our drinking water practice. We are also open to highly qualified candidates located in California or Georgia who can support regional clients and projects.  


In this role, you will partner directly with municipal clients to evaluate, plan, design, and deliver a variety of drinking water infrastructure projects. You will work closely with our Technical Managers and multidisciplinary teams to successfully execute projects involving water treatment facilities, transmission and distribution systems, storage infrastructure, master planning initiatives, regulatory compliance programs, and capital improvement projects.  


Our team consists of engineers, scientists, and design professionals dedicated to delivering innovative clean water solutions. You'll have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across the country while contributing to projects that make a lasting impact on communities.  


To support the successful addition of top talent, we are offering a competitive sign\-on bonus and employee ownership opportunities for qualified candidates seeking a long\-term leadership role within our employee\-owned firm.  


At Woodard \& Curran, ownership is more than a benefit. It is an opportunity to directly contribute to and share in the success of the company while helping shape the future of our growing drinking water practice.

**Why Woodard \& Curran?**
* Employee ownership opportunities
* Competitive sign\-on bonus
* Flexible remote work environment
* Opportunity to lead high\-profile drinking water projects
* Influence the growth and direction of a thriving drinking water practice
* Collaborate with industry\-leading drinking water experts
* Strong culture focused on technical excellence, innovation, and employee development
* Clear path for continued leadership growth and increased responsibility
* Opportunity to help expand our presence in key growth markets

  


**Who We Are Looking For**

We are seeking a technically focused, detail\-oriented, and client\-focused Professional Engineer who is passionate about delivering innovative drinking water solutions and helping communities solve their most complex water challenges.  


As a Project Manager, you will partner with municipal clients to develop, design, and deliver a variety of drinking water projects throughout Florida and other key growth markets. Working closely with Technical Managers, engineers, scientists, and design professionals, you will help lead the successful delivery of multiple projects while coordinating directly with clients and internal teams.  


The ideal candidate will be technically focused, with solid experience evaluating, planning, designing, and constructing drinking water systems. Familiarity with a broad range of drinking water challenges related to master planning, treatment facilities, and distribution systems is preferred.  


In collaboration with Technical Managers and national drinking water experts, you will oversee project scope, schedule, budget, and client communications while supporting marketing initiatives, proposal development, and strategic growth efforts within the drinking water practice.  


This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys leading projects, building strong client relationships, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, mentoring emerging professionals, and helping grow a successful and sustainable water practice.  


**Location: Remote \| Florida Preferred**

We recognize that top drinking water talent can make an impact from anywhere. While Florida is the preferred location, we are also open to exceptional candidates located in California or Georgia.  


Candidates should have the ability to support regional clients, participate in occasional travel for project delivery and business development activities, and collaborate with colleagues across our national water practice.  


**Travel**

Up to 20% Travel

Travel may include client meetings, project site visits, business development activities, industry conferences, and collaboration with Woodard \& Curran teams throughout the region.  


**Join a Firm Where Your Expertise Matters**

If you are a licensed Professional Engineer with drinking water infrastructure experience and are looking for a career\-defining opportunity that combines project leadership, ownership potential, professional growth, and meaningful client impact, we invite you to explore a future with Woodard \& Curran.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Scheduler)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**



We are an international group of consultants united in the goal of helping our customers revolutionize their approach to engineering problems with the use of digital technologies. Combining automation and software development with “traditional” engineering, the companies we work with are able to obtain visibility into their own operations and control.


**Who We’re Looking For**



Though over 1,600 strong (and growing!), Radix operates like anything but a large company. When you join our company, you will help us:



 The Project Planner will work closely with program, project, and sites teams. The focus will be on transforming roadmaps with milestones and deliverables for \~ 21 workstreams into site level schedules and oversee the execution of the site activities. The Project Planner will need to be able to organize working sessions to develop plans per site, create the activity schedule for each site, create the RAID log for each site, build resource capacity reports and develop rollup reports to monitor progress of the site and it workstreams. Once the plan is established, the professional will need to support the execution by establishing reoccurring meetings to gather updates on progress of the planned schedule, follow up on actions, issues, decisions, and update risk related to the work.


**Responsibilities:**


* Create, update, and maintain project schedules using management tools.
* Structure activities, milestones, dependencies, and critical path, evaluating the impacts of changes.
* Perform capacity planning and resource leveling, proposing scenarios when necessary.
* Monitor work items with teams and consolidate status and deadlines.
* Identify and communicate schedule risks and mitigation recommendations.
* Generate Gantt charts and schedule reports for stakeholders and governance rituals.
* Create and manage RAID logs (Risks, Actions, Issues, Dependencies).
* Coordinate between site and central project teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and milestones.
* Organize and facilitate project meetings and workshops.
* Consolidate and provide regular status reports to stakeholders, highlighting achievements, challenges, and upcoming priorities.


**Eligibility Requirements:**


* 5\+ years of project coordination or project management experience, ideally within Oil \& Gas or a similar industrial environment.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable working with engineers, technicians, and leadership skills.
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet, or similar).
* Good understanding of digital transformation initiatives and comfort with technical conversations.
* Change management or stakeholder engagement experience is a strong plus.
* English fluency (written and spoken) is required; other languages are a plus


 **It's a plus if you have:**


* PMP certification (or equivalent).

jobs.title: Marketing Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.**  

  

**Who We Are**  

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go\-to\-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350\+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture\-backed, high\-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit www.marketbridge.com and follow www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/. **Who We're Looking For**


We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to join our Workflow and Project Management team. This role is ideal for an energetic problem\-solver and strong communicator who thrives in a fast\-paced advertising or marketing agency environment.


As a Project Coordinator, you will support the planning and delivery of integrated marketing projects, working closely with teams across Client Success, Strategy and Media, Creative, and Marketing Technology and Operations. You will help keep projects organized, timelines on track, and stakeholders informed while ensuring teams have the information and resources needed to produce high\-quality work.


The successful candidate is detail\-oriented, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple projects and shifting priorities. You anticipate needs, follow through on commitments, and approach challenges with curiosity and a solutions\-oriented mindset. You are eager to learn new technologies, strengthen your project management capabilities, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes. Experience supporting B2B marketing programs is an asset.

 **Responsibilities**

**Project Coordination**

* Coordinate the planning, scheduling, resourcing, and execution of a variety of integrated marketing initiatives.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, task assignments, status reports, meeting notes, and other project documentation.
* Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables to help ensure work is completed on time, within scope, and in alignment with the approved brief.
* Anticipate potential project issues and roadblocks, communicate concerns promptly, and partner with project leads to support timely resolution.
* Assist with the preparation of project estimates and track project hours, budgets, and scope against approved plans.
* Work with Client Success and strategy teams to ensure project briefs are complete, requirements are clearly defined, and timelines are achievable.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure they have the direction, information, and resources needed to complete their work successfully.
* Help manage changes to project scope, schedules, or deliverables and ensure updates are clearly documented and communicated.
* Support project closeout activities, including confirming deliverables, organizing final files, and documenting key learnings.

**Workflow Management**

* Support established project management processes and help ensure they are followed consistently across assigned projects.
* Maintain project information, documentation, and workflows within the appropriate systems and tools.
* Identify potential process gaps or inefficiencies and recommend opportunities to improve how work is planned and delivered.
* Help coordinate resources and priorities across teams, escalating scheduling conflicts or capacity concerns as needed.

**Communication and Collaboration**

* Communicate project goals, priorities, responsibilities, deadlines, and status updates clearly and consistently to internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate or support project meetings, including preparing agendas, documenting decisions, and tracking follow\-up actions.
* Build positive and collaborative working relationships across teams and functions.
* Escalate risks, delays, and competing priorities to the appropriate project or account lead in a timely manner.

 **Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of related project coordination, project management, account management, or marketing operations experience, preferably within an advertising or marketing agency.
* A post\-secondary degree in business, marketing, communications, project management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands, adapt to changing requirements, and remain composed in a deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating multiple projects and collaborating with cross\-functional teams within established timelines and budgets.
* Familiarity with integrated marketing programs, including creative, digital, media, and marketing automation deliverables.
* Experience using project management or workflow platforms (ie: Asana, Workbook, ClickUp, Scoro, etc.)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across different teams and levels of the organization.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with strong attention to detail.
* A collaborative, solutions\-oriented approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Familiarity with project briefs, timelines, budgets, resource schedules, milestones, risks, and deliverables.
* A demonstrated commitment to accountability, follow\-through, and continuous learning.
* Experience supporting B2B marketing programs is an asset.
* CAPM or another relevant project management certification is an asset but not required.

 **Our Culture**


Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.


How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. **Be Kind** means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. **Be Open** reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback

jobs.title: Odoo Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are an Official Odoo Partner and Odoo Accounting Expert Partner, providing ERP implementation, migration, customization, and support services to clients across Manufacturing, Retail, Construction, Utilities, Services, and Outdoor Recreation. We've been an exclusive Odoo implementation and customization partner since 2015, and we're growing fast. We're looking for a Project Manager who can run multiple concurrent ERP engagements with minimal oversight, protect project margin, and keep clients confident and informed from kickoff through go\-live.

**What You'll Do**

● Own the full project lifecycle for multiple concurrent Odoo implementation, migration and service engagements — from kickoff through go\-live and stabilization

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing day\-to\-day communication, status updates, and expectations

● Identify scope expansion the moment it appears, communicate write up details of tasks and client needs and communicate that to our developer team and oversee the work to ensure that it meets the client needs.

● Coordinate with developers and technical staff to translate business requirements into actionable, tasks — without directing technical implementation decisions yourself

● Track hours, budget, and milestones against the Statement of Work; flag at\-risk timelines and margin issues early

● Facilitate discovery, design confirmation, UAT, and Go\-Live Acceptance Checklist sign\-off with clients

● Distinguish between billable enhancements and no\-charge defects, and hold that line consistently with clients

● Designate and formally introduce a secondary PM for each assigned client to ensure continuous coverage

● Provide clear, professional written documentation of every scope decision, timeline change, and client agreement

● Escalate unresolved issues or at\-risk relationships to executive leadership with a clear recommendation, not just a status report

**What You Bring**

● 3\+ years of Odoo project management experience in ERP implementation, migrations and service work.

● A current Odoo Certification preferred but not required, Direct experience managing Odoo projects required. Unfortunately experience with another major ERP platform such as NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics, Epicor is not a substitute for Odoo ERP experience.

● Proven ability to manage scope discipline — recognizing scope creep, pricing it, and getting client sign\-off without damaging the relationship

● Strong working knowledge of core ERP business processes: sales, inventory, accounting, manufacturing, and CRM workflows

● Excellent spoken English along with excellent written and verbal communication skills is required

● Highly organized, self\-directed, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously in a remote environment

● Experience with formal Go\-Live acceptance, UAT coordination, and change order/SOW documentation processes

● PMP, CSM, or other formal project management certification a plus, but not required

**Required**

● Background in a Odoo software consultancy or implementation partner (rather than an internal in\-house PM role)

● Familiarity with Odoo data migration projects and legacy system transitions

● Experience managing projects in Odoo ERP platforms

● You must reside inside the USA and speak fluent english

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently reside inside the USA and are you able to work USA based business hours?

Experience:

* Odoo: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

License/Certification:

* Odoo Certification (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Controls Program Manager (Remote Eligible, U.S.)
jobs.description:
Vernova Purpose
  

  

GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers power economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world?
  

  

What impact you’ll make
  

  

As a member of the Gas Power Controls Program Management Office (PMO) team, you will be responsible for leading and facilitating the execution of New Product Introduction (NPI) engineering development programs through all phases of the Gas Power product life cycle. As a key leadership position within the organization, this role is essential for effective operation through active management of project execution, risks and mitigations to meet our commitments to the business, while maintaining critical business metrics to ensure quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of our NPI deliverables.
**Job Description**
===================


**Essential Responsibilities**

  

  

* Provide program management execution for assigned projects in accordance with GE Gas Power Program Managers Standard Work procedure.
* Create and maintain internal and external project schedules.
* Validate proper resource assignment and manage spending per the plan.
* Guide internal and external execution teams through the NPI Development Process, assuring the proper adherence to engineering policies and procedures.
* Coordinate activities between engineering sub\-functions to ensure all project deliverables are met on time, complete, properly tested, and documented.
* Actively manage program risks and mitigations to avoid execution misses.
* Communicate program status and issues to the engineering and commercial stakeholders.
* Provide regular spending status and projections to the Business Operations and Quality teams.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**  



  

* Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Mathematics, or Computer Science.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in engineering or program/project management of engineered systems.
  

  

  

**Desired Qualifications**

  

  

* Exceptional communication skills and the ability to interface with leadership with confidence and clarity.
* Knowledge of GE Power project tracking tools, processes, and practices.
* Engineering program graduate or advanced engineering degree.
* Prior experience in electronic hardware or software development.
* Knowledgeable of engineering, manufacturing and customer service processes.
* Strong organizational/ project execution skills and prior success in working with or leading cross\-functional teams.
* Customer satisfaction mindset.
* Demonstrated leadership, team building, and communication skills.
* Highly motivated, energetic, confident, self\-starting personal characteristics.
* Influences through others; builds direct and "behind the scenes" support for ideas. Identifies opportunities and actively pursues appropriate changes with the input and support of the team.
* Able to work well with global teams, including time\-zone flexibility when necessary.

jobs.title: FedRAMP Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


**FedRAMP Project Manager**
===========================


**Location:** Remote – US **Work Model:** Remote


**About the Role**
------------------


The FedRAMP Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering Hyland's FedRAMP authorization initiative and related government cloud compliance projects. This role works across Engineering, Cloud Operations, Security, GRC, Product, Legal, Finance, PMO, and external partners to manage project execution, schedules, dependencies, risks, budgets, and reporting. Reporting to the PMO, the FedRAMP Project Manager coordinates project governance activities, accelerator and assessment partner engagements, and delivery of milestones required to achieve authorization readiness and compliance objectives.


**Here's What You'll Do**
-------------------------

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Latent Health**
-----------------------


Latent Health is redefining how healthcare systems unlock the power of clinical data. Through our AI\-powered platform, we streamline clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve health system efficiency. We partner with leading hospitals and health systems to deliver fast, reliable, and high\-impact implementations that transform patient care.

**Role Overview**
=================


The **Implementation Project Manager** is responsible for leading end\-to\-end onboarding and deployment projects for health systems adopting Latent’s platform. You’ll drive timelines, coordination, communication, and successful activation across clinical, IT, integration, and operational stakeholders.


This role requires exceptional organization, customer\-facing presence, and the ability to operate in the dynamic environment of a high\-growth healthcare SaaS startup. You will ensure customers go live efficiently, achieve measurable value quickly, and are set up for long\-term success.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Project Leadership \& Customer Delivery**

* Lead full\-cycle implementation projects – from kickoff through go\-live and stabilization – across a portfolio of health system customers.
* Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and risk logs.
* Facilitate cross\-functional meetings with customer IT, clinical operations, and technical teams (e.g., data integration, SSO, EHR workflows).
* Serve as the primary project point of contact, ensuring exceptional communication and alignment across all parties.

### **Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate collection and validation of required technical inputs (integration specifications, data feeds, configuration requirements).
* Partner with Latent engineering, product, and clinical teams to ensure smooth handoffs and timely execution.
* Understand and translate technical requirements to non\-technical stakeholders (and vice versa).
* Monitor progress of integrations (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and escalate blockers proactively.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Own project documentation, including requirements tracking, decisions, status updates, risk mitigation plans, and post\-go\-live handoff materials.
* Build repeatable processes and contribute to the evolution of Latent’s implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Track and report project KPIs (e.g., activation timelines, milestone adherence, customer readiness).
* Ensure clean transition to Support teams post\-implementation.

### **Customer Relationship \& Change Management**

* Build trusted relationships with clinical and operational leaders at customer sites.
* Guide customers through workflow adoption, training readiness, and change\-management planning.
* Ensure customer stakeholders understand project expectations, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Drive customer accountability to keep projects on track and on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

### **Required**

* 3\-7 years of project management experience in healthcare, SaaS implementations, or health IT.
* Strong understanding of healthcare environments – clinical operations, IT workflows, data integrations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and navigate competing priorities.
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com).
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

### **Preferred**

* Experience implementing solutions with EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Meditech).
* PMP, CSM, or other project management certification.
* Background in clinical workflow optimization or healthcare operations.
* Prior experience in Series A\-C SaaS or health\-tech companies.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
===================================

* Customers consistently launch on time, on budget, and with high satisfaction.
* Clear, proactive communication minimizes surprises and escalations.
* Implementation cycles shorten over time due to improved processes and customer readiness.
* Cross\-functional teams view you as a trusted coordinator and problem\-solver.
* Customers transition seamlessly to Customer Success with strong early adoption signals.

**Why Latent Health**
=====================

* Mission\-driven team transforming healthcare through cutting\-edge AI.
* Fast\-growing environment with opportunities for career growth.
* Deep collaboration across clinical, technical, and product teams.
* A chance to make a real impact on clinician workflows and patient outcomes.

  

Compensation Range: $115K \- $175K

jobs.title: Project Manager - Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
#### **Who We Are**


Xtensys is a rapidly growing managed service provider delivering innovative technology solutions to health systems, beginning in New York and expanding nationwide. Owned by two industry leaders with a strong focus on advancing rural and community healthcare, Xtensys is executing several major initiatives and scaling quickly. With a team of more than 500 professionals, we are building a people\-centered culture rooted in collaboration, innovation, and strategic thinking.



We are seeking an experienced Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives to lead cross\-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the organization. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Initiatives, this position partners with technology, clinical, operational, business, and other stakeholders to plan and execute projects that advance organizational priorities.



Projects will vary based on organizational priorities and may include healthcare technology implementations, enterprise applications, system integrations, clinical and business systems, operational and process improvements, cybersecurity and risk initiatives, vendor implementations, and other strategic or cross\-functional projects assigned. The role also performs business analysis activities, including requirements gathering, workflow and process documentation, and translating business objectives into actionable project plans.


#### **How We Work:**

* East Coast Alignment: Our core operational and collaboration hours follow the Eastern Time Zone (ET), keeping our workflows synchronized with our primary clients and systems.

#### **Why Join Us?**

* MissionDriven Work: You are the "bridge" ensuring technology serves health systems and their patients when they need it most.
* Autonomy \& Ownership: We trust you. You’ll lead projects, define success, and manage complexities with total support.
* A Culture of Innovation: Have a fresh perspective? We want it. We encourage risktaking and continuous improvement.
* Continuous Growth: We fuel your "restless curiosity" with opportunities to expand your skillset and mentor others.


The Role: This is an experienced\-level project management position requiring a current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification and demonstrated success managing projects within healthcare IT or healthcare technology environments. The Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, independently manages assigned projects from initiation through implementation and closeout while exercising sound judgment regarding risks, priorities, stakeholder needs, and issues requiring escalation.


#### **Work Arrangement:**

* Work arrangement will be based on business needs and the requirements of assigned projects. The role requires effective collaboration with geographically distributed teams and availability during established business hours and projectrelated meetings.

#### **Your Mission: What You’ll Do Day\-to\-Day:**

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned projects through the full project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, implementation, and closeout.
* Partner with project sponsors and stakeholders to define objectives, scope, requirements, deliverables, timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and measures of success.
* Develop and maintain project charters, project plans, schedules, work breakdown structures, communication plans, risk and issue logs, decision logs, status reports, and other project documentation as appropriate.
* Perform business analysis activities by gathering and documenting business and functional requirements and assisting with currentstate and futurestate process and workflow documentation.
* Coordinate project activities across technical, clinical, operational, business, vendor, and other stakeholder groups; establish clear roles, responsibilities, expectations, and deadlines.
* Track project scope, schedule, milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, decisions, action items, and, when applicable, budget; identify deviations and coordinate corrective action.
* Proactively identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, constraints, and resource challenges; escalate concerns appropriately when leadership decisions or support are required.
* Manage changes to project scope, requirements, timelines, and deliverables using established project governance and changecontrol practices.
* Develop and execute project communication plans and provide timely, accurate status updates to project sponsors, stakeholders, and leadership.
* Schedule and facilitate project meetings, working sessions, status reviews, and decision forums that result in clear actions, owners, and accountability.
* Build effective working relationships across departments and lead through coordination and influence in a matrixed environment.
* Coordinate activities with thirdparty vendors, consultants, and implementation partners; track commitments, dependencies, deliverables, and performance.
* Support project implementation, transition, closeout, and lessonslearned activities and identify opportunities to improve project delivery practices.
* Support the Director of Strategic Initiatives with organizational priorities, special projects, and crossfunctional initiatives as assigned.


Who You Are \& What You’ll Bring


* 35 years of progressively responsible project management experience, including demonstrated experience independently managing complex, crossfunctional IT or technologyenabled projects.
* Demonstrated project management experience within healthcare IT, healthcare technology, a health system, or a similarly complex healthcare environment.
* Experience coordinating projects involving multiple technical, clinical, operational, business, and/or vendor stakeholder groups.
* Experience with project planning, requirements gathering, process and workflow documentation, risk and issue management, change control, stakeholder management, and status reporting

If you thrive at the intersection of program management, data\-driven decision\-making, and stakeholder collaboration, this is a high\-visibility opportunity to make a real impact.

Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Reports to:** Senior Director, Solution Delivery


**Location:** Remote, Must be located in Eastern Time zone


At PTC, we embrace the power of transformation. Together, we make an impact across industries by enabling companies to bring products to market faster, improve quality, and increase innovation.


Arena, a PTC business, provides industry\-leading cloud\-native Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Quality Management System (QMS) solutions that help companies accelerate product development while maintaining compliance and operational excellence.


As Arena continues to grow, our customers are implementing increasingly sophisticated solutions that span product development, quality management, analytics, supply chain collaboration, automation, and enterprise integrations. To help customers realize value faster, we are investing in a dedicated implementation management capability focused on project governance, customer accountability, and implementation excellence.


**Overview**

The Senior Implementation Program Manager is responsible for leading complex customer onboarding and implementation programs for Arena PLM and QMS. This role serves as the primary owner of implementation execution, customer accountability, project governance, risk management, executive communication, and delivery forecasting.


Working closely with Solution Architects, Customer Success Coaches, Technical Consultants, Account Managers, and customer stakeholders, the Senior Implementation Program Manager ensures projects remain on schedule, risks are proactively managed, and customers are prepared to make timely decisions throughout the onboarding journey.


The ideal candidate combines enterprise SaaS implementation experience, outstanding customer\-facing skills, strong executive presence, and the ability to drive accountability across both customer and internal teams.


This role is responsible for implementation success but is not responsible for solution design, configuration, training delivery, or technical implementation activities.


**Senior Implementation Program Manager Duties**

* Own and drive the successful execution of strategic customer implementations by developing and managing project plans, milestones, timelines, and deliverables. Ensure alignment with defined success criteria while coordinating activities across customer and internal teams to maintain momentum throughout the implementation lifecycle. Lead and manage multiple projects to ensure the realization of value, quality, and on\-time delivery of the defined scope
* Establish clear customer responsibilities, milestones, and expectations. Drive customer accountability for commitments, timelines, and deliverables, and proactively identify and escalate risks that could impact implementation success
* Establish a structured executive communication framework that promotes transparency, accountability, and informed decision\-making throughout the implementation lifecycle. Deliver concise status updates, facilitate governance discussions, and cultivate strong relationships with customer leadership to drive project success
* Own the ongoing refinement of the standardized project schedules, reporting frameworks, and governance templates that promote consistency across implementations. Continuously assess delivery performance and recommend process enhancements that improve predictability, resource utilization, and implementation outcomes
* Develop and strengthen project management capabilities within Solution Delivery by coaching team members, sharing best practices, and building leadership skills across the organization. Drive the establishment of a scalable PMO framework that supports growth, operational maturity, and successful customer outcomes
* Jointly work with partners and support partner projects as needed
Operates and participates in customer steering committees  
* 

**Required Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in program/project implementation management leadership
* Proven track record of managing enterprise\-level transformation programs
* Exceptional customer written and verbal communication, executive engagement, and stakeholder management skills
* Accustomed to preparing for and leading steering committee meetings
* Navigate difficult implementation discussions with confidence and professionalism
* Lead full project lifecycles leveraging either traditional PMI Process or Scrum/Agile approach
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects
* Bachelor’s degree required

**Preferred Experience**

* Knowledge of and experience with industry\-specific processes with High\-tech Electronics, Medical Device, and/or Aerospace \& Defense manufacturers
* Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and/or Quality Management System (QMS) system experience
* Expertise using Smartsheet
* Experience with Cloud\-based, Software as a Service offerings
* PMP or PgMP certification or equivalent is highly desirable

**This position is not eligible for employment\-based immigration sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future sponsorship from PTC.**

jobs.title: Home Infusion Intake Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Home Infusion Intake Coordinator**
====================================



**100% Remote**



### **Home Infusion or Infusion Center Experience Required**



**Please note: Candidates must have previous Intake, Benefits Verification, or Authorization experience in a Home Infusion, Specialty Pharmacy, or Infusion Center setting.**

**Join Advanced Infusion Care**
-------------------------------



Advanced Infusion Care (AIC), a division of AIS Healthcare, is the leading provider of home infusion therapies and specialty pharmacy services. Guided by our core values of Innovation, Stewardship, and Unity, we are committed to Advancing Quality and Improving Lives for the patients, providers, and communities we serve.



We are seeking an experienced Intake Coordinator to join our growing team. This is a critical role responsible for ensuring patients have timely access to life\-changing infusion therapies by managing insurance verification, benefits investigation, prior authorizations, and patient onboarding activities.



If you thrive in a fast\-paced healthcare environment, have strong infusion intake experience, and enjoy helping patients navigate complex insurance requirements, we'd love to hear from you.



**Why Join AIS Healthcare?**
----------------------------



We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:



* 100% Remote Work Opportunity
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Company\-Paid Life Insurance
* Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Career Growth and Advancement Opportunities
* Collaborative Team Environment
* Mission\-Driven Culture Focused on Patient Care

**Position Summary**
--------------------



The Intake Coordinator is responsible for providing patient access to infusion therapies by verifying insurance eligibility, reviewing benefits, obtaining authorizations, and coordinating communication between patients, providers, nursing, pharmacy, and sales teams.



This role requires a strong understanding of infusion reimbursement, medical and pharmacy benefits, prior authorizations, and patient onboarding workflows.


**This is not a general medical intake position. Candidates must have prior experience working in a Home Infusion, Specialty Pharmacy, or Infusion Center environment.**



**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Enter patient, physician, insurance, and authorization information into company systems
* Review incoming referrals and prescription orders
* Contact patients and providers to obtain missing information
* Conduct comprehensive benefits investigations for new referrals
* Review both medical and pharmacy benefit plans
* Obtain clinical documentation needed for prior authorization submissions
* Follow authorizations through approval and resolution
* Communicate authorization status updates to patients, providers, and internal teams
* Manage denials and assist providers with appeals and peer\-to\-peer review processes
* Educate patients regarding coverage and financial responsibility
* Coordinate care across Nursing, Pharmacy, Sales, and Reimbursement teams
* Assist patients with manufacturer assistance programs and financial support options
* Maintain detailed documentation in patient records
* Identify alternate pharmacy providers when required by payer restrictions
* Support training and development of new team members
* Participate in process improvement initiatives and workflow optimization projects

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* High School Diploma or GED
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in:
	+ Home Infusion Intake
	+ Specialty Pharmacy Intake
	+ Infusion Center Intake
	+ Authorization or Benefits Verification within an infusion environment
* Experience with insurance verification, benefits investigation, and prior authorizations
* Strong understanding of medical and pharmacy benefits
* Excellent communication and customer service skills
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Advanced organizational and time management skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel

**How to Apply**
----------------



To be considered for this position, you must complete the **Culture Index Assessment**.


**Culture Index Assessment:**  

http://portal.cultureindex.com/public/survey/general/0BFB8F0000


**Important:** Applications will not be reviewed until the assessment has been completed.



If the assessment link does not open when clicked, please copy and paste the URL directly into your browser. If you continue to experience issues, try using a different browser.



**About AIS Healthcare**
------------------------



AIS Healthcare is the nation's leading provider of advanced sterile, patient\-specific intrathecal pump medications and in\-home infusion therapies, including immune globulin treatments. Through innovative pharmacy services, specialized nursing support, and comprehensive care coordination, we help providers deliver exceptional patient care and outcomes.



We're looking for positive, hardworking professionals who are passionate about making a difference in the lives of patients and providers.


**AIS Healthcare \| Advancing Quality. Improving Lives.**

Tenna is searching for a dedicated and experienced Project Coordinator to join our Field ServicesTeam. The ideal candidate will have a background in construction, scheduling expertise, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple projects. As a Project Coordinator, you will be responsible for various tasks, including reviewing expense and timesheet coding, scheduling, managing work orders, providing customer follow\-up support, creating and editing implementation plans, auditing asset\-to\-tracker matches, and handling ad hoc projects. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to the successful execution of customer installations while utilizing your scheduling expertise, and project management capabilities. If you are a proactive, detail\-oriented individual who excels in a fast\-paced environment – apply now!

**Why Tenna?**
At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us, and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe that every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible. When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality\-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets anytime, anywhere, on one comprehensive platform. Apply now!  


### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Review expense coding to ensure accuracy and compliance with project budgets
* Audit all travel and transportation arrangements to ensure they are made according to Tenna’s Travel \& Expense Policy
* Verify and analyze timesheet coding, ensuring proper allocation of labor costs and adherence to company policies
* Assist in the development and maintenance of installation project schedules, ensuring tasks are correctly sequenced, and resource allocation is optimized

jobs.description:
OneSource Virtual (OSV) has worked exclusively with Workday customers since 2008 to deliver compliant, in\-tenant technology and expert services to automate the administrative, transactional tasks of payroll, taxes, earned wage access, accounts payable, and benefits. With over 1,500 customers, 92% retention, and $225\+ billion in treasury movement annually, OSV helps organizations maximize their Workday investment and operate it with confidence. Payroll, benefits, and finance solutions — all in one place.

**\*This is a Temporary/Seasonal Contract role expected to last approximately 3 months or longer\***

 **Job Profile Summary**


The Contract Service Delivery Trainer is responsible for designing and delivering job\-specific onboarding and readiness training with a concentrated focus on Workday and OSV’s BPaaS systems and processes. This is a defined\-term engagement to support a hiring surge. The successful candidate is adept at translating complex payroll operations into clear, actionable training for everyone from entry\-level coordinators to seasoned payroll managers. Delivery offerings include role\-based curriculum, sandbox\-based hands\-on practice, virtual instructor\-led sessions, and post\-go\-live hyper\-care support.

 **Essential** **Functions/Duties/Responsibilities**

*Other duties may be requested and/or assigned within the scope of the contract term.*

* **Training Needs Assessment –** Confer with Lead Trainer, Service Delivery leadership, and subject matter experts to identify development needs and priorities specific to Payroll (US/Global).
* **Curriculum Development –** Design and develop training curricula, course materials, and learning assets using instructional design best practices.
* **Sandbox Environment Management –** Set up and maintain Workday training environments to support realistic, hands\-on practice without disrupting live production data.
* **Training Delivery –** Lead engaging virtual ILT sessions for diverse audiences, including payroll processors, specialists, and seasonal employees; incorporate microlearning where appropriate.
* **Evaluation \& Optimization –** Assess training effectiveness via surveys and knowledge checks.
* **Administration –** Coordinate training schedules, registrations, and invites for the duration of the contract; maintain training records and rosters, and hand off documentation at contract end.

 **Qualifications and Experience**

* 3\+ years specializing in Workday Payroll training or system administration
* Deep understanding of Workday business processes (BPs), security groups, and reporting structures related to payroll
* Experience with gross\-to\-net calculations, tax compliance, year\-end processing, wage garnishments, and multi\-state/global payroll compliance
* Fast learner able to acclimate quickly to a new tenant, team, and payroll policy set within a compressed contract timeline
* Ability to manage multiple training deliverables independently with limited guidance and minimal ramp\-up support
* Excellent public speaking, facilitation, and written communication skills; patience with non\-technical learners

 **Preferred Certifications**

* Workday Pro (Payroll or HCM)
* Certified Payroll Professional (CPP)

  

\#LI\-REMOTE


You are encouraged to learn and share ideas when you join the OneSource Virtual team. We reward innovative thinking, fresh perspectives, creative collaboration, and hard work. As an organization experiencing routine strategic growth, we are always on the lookout for intelligent, talented, and forward\-thinking professionals to join our team. OSV employees enjoy a values\-based culture, upward mobility, and professional development with opportunities of all kinds.

jobs.title: Analytics Program Lead
jobs.description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.



Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission\-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We're inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world\-class medicine through world\-class operations. \#LI\-MB1

**About the role:**
-------------------



We're looking for a Senior / Staff Analytics Program Lead to own the analytics product program across our global Analytics organization. While our solution analytics leads own the definitions and insights for a single solution, this role owns the analytics product function as a system: how analytics products get built, how they hold together across solutions, and how fast we can ship the next one. You are accountable for the coherence, quality, and velocity of everything the analytics function delivers, internal and external, and for steering the function toward more self\-serve and agentic analytics, where trusted metric definitions let customers, internal teams, and AI agents answer more questions without an analyst in the loop.



This is a hybrid role. Most of your time goes to running the program: enforcing and evolving the analytics standards and ways of working that let each pod ship correctly, scoping and sequencing work across solutions, and partnering with platform, data/BI engineering, and context architecture to shape the technical \& semantic foundations our analytics products are built on, especially as we scale towards enabling increased self\-service with AI tools. The rest is hands\-on. You will jump into a domain as an individual contributor when the hardest problems need you, both to unblock the team and to stay closely aligned the work you're setting the bar for. If you are energized by taking a pattern you know works and re\-establishing it at a broader scale, this is that role.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------



At Qventus, Analytics is treated as a first\-class product, rather than a secondary output. As the Analytics Program Lead, you will:


* Own delivery of coherent, high\-quality, on\-time analytics products across solutions, and hold the bar for products that are stable, maintainable, and easy to iterate and enhance over time
* Increase the velocity at which we build and ship analytics products by enforcing and shaping standards, developing analytics AI skills and context, and evolving team structures, in partnership with our Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product teams
* Lead the solution analytics leads as their manager, owning how the analytics team works day to day, scoping and sequencing work across solutions, and keeping people unblocked and focused
* Partner with our Data Platform Manager and Data Context \& Semantic Architect to shape the BI platform and semantic architecture that supports both our standard embedded analytics products and the move toward self\-service analytics (incl. Analytics agents)
* Stay hands\-on, contributing directly as an IC in a domain when the work demands it, to unblock the team and to keep close to the craft you're holding others to

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------


* Demonstrated program ownership of a technical function: you have scoped, sequenced, and shipped analytics or data work across multiple parallel workstreams and held ultimate responsibility for quality and coherence, not just your own output
* Strong analytical rigor: you can take an ambiguous question to a precise, defensible answer, with the hands\-on depth (SQL/dbt, modern warehouse and BI) to do the work yourself and set the standard, not just review against it
* A systems\-builder instinct: you turn what works into repeatable process, standards, and enforcement that keep running without you, rather than holding the function together through personal effort
* Cross\-functional influence across teams you don't directly control, with a track record of driving alignment when interpretations differ and holding durable working relationships with platform, engineering, and architecture partners
* Comfort with ambiguity and scale: you can take a coherent way of working that you've proven and re\-establish it at broader scale across solutions and teams

**It's a Plus if You Have…**
----------------------------


* Expertise in the healthcare domain and familiarity with healthcare operational data, clinical workflows, hospital operations, or common healthcare measurement challenges
* Experience scaling an analytics function at a growing company, taking something that worked at smaller scale and rebuilding it as a system others can run
* Familiarity with data governance, metric governance, or semantic layer concepts, especially where consistency across teams, solutions, or customer implementations is critical
* Experience with data logic implemented in dbt and data visualization in Sigma, and with knowledge management systems for documenting metric definitions and analytical decisions
* Exposure to AI\-enabled analytics, natural language analytics, or agentic analytics workflows, especially where high\-quality metric definitions and trusted analytical context are required for safe and useful AI outputs

==================

===========


**Type:** Contract (short\-term through end of year)

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. As an Electrical Installation Project Coordinator, you will help manage residential backup power installation projects from initial customer intake to final completion. This role focuses on customer communication, electrician coordination, project follow\-up, documentation, and helping ensure each installation moves forward smoothly.

The ideal candidate will have an electrical engineering, electrical technology, construction, or field service background. Experience working with electricians or electrical contractors is strongly preferred. Experience preparing or supporting electrical drawings and permit\-related documents is a plus, but not required.

This role is a strong fit for someone who understands basic electrical concepts, communicates clearly with both customers and electricians, and can stay organized while managing multiple installation projects.

**What You Will Do**

* Manage assigned installation orders from initial assignment to job completion.
* Contact electricians to confirm availability, scheduling, estimates, permits, and installation progress.
* Communicate with customers and answer questions about the installation process.
* Explain which electrician will be handling the installation and help coordinate next steps.
* Follow up with both customers and electricians until the installation is fully completed.
* Track job status, notes, documents, photos, and completion forms in our internal system.
* Help make sure required documents, permits, photos, and completion information are collected properly.
* Escalate issues when customers or electricians need additional support.
* Maintain professional, clear, and patient communication with all parties.

**What You Need to Succeed**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Patient, responsible, and detail\-oriented.
* Ability to communicate clearly with both customers and electricians.
* Able to follow up consistently without dropping tasks.
* Willing to learn about home electrical installations and backup power systems.
* Organized and able to manage multiple jobs at the same time.
* Professional, polite, and calm when handling customer questions or job delays.
* Hardworking and dependable.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in electrical engineering, electrical design, electrical technology, construction, or a related technical field.
* 2\+ years experience in managing and coordinating electrical projects, or experience working as an electrical engineer, electrical designer, field engineer, permit coordinator, or electrical project assistant.
* 1\+ years experience in customer service, scheduling, coordination, or administrative work.
* Experience preparing electrical drawings or permit documents for residential or light commercial electrical projects.

**Requirements**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Reliable follow\-through and attention to detail.
* Comfortable using online tools, forms, spreadsheets, and basic CRM/project tracking systems.
* Ability to work independently and keep tasks moving.
* Willingness to learn technical installation details over time.

**What You Will Learn**

* Field service operations and installation coordination.
* Customer communication and issue resolution.
* How residential backup power and electrical installation projects are managed.
* How to work with electricians, customers, and internal teams.
* Real\-world operations experience in a growing service business.

$19 \- $25/hr

Compensation will be based on experience, availability, and role scope.

Performance\-based bonus may be available based on individual performance, job completion quality, follow\-through, and business needs.
