jobs.title: Manager of Scaled Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


Leadfeeder turns B2B websites into lead generation engines. Every day, potential buyers visit your website and leave without filling out a form. Leadfeeder reveals which companies are behind that traffic, shows what they care about, and helps teams act while interest is high.


By connecting website behavior with company data, intent signals, and automated workflows, Leadfeeder helps marketing and sales teams prioritise the right accounts and turn anonymous traffic into qualified pipeline.


We’re a remote\-first, international team building the next generation of lead generation technology for B2B marketers. Join us and help redefine how B2B companies generate leads from the signals already happening on their website.

**Position Overview**


Leadfeeder is modernising Customer Success to work at scale, not just at the top of the customer base. This role covers the majority of our customers, so how it's run shapes what most people experience after they buy.


The goal: a lifecycle where customers reach first value fast, build a habit, renew, and grow — supported by programs where programs do the job, and a named CSM where the relationship earns it.
  

  

The team delivers that lifecycle through three connected motions:

* Priority coverage — a smaller group of customers per region gets a named CSM, chosen by value concentration or risk.
* Digital programs — the long tail is covered without a named owner: triggered outreach, one\-to\-many programs (office hours, webinars), self\-serve content, and a shared expansion queue.
* Onboarding — every new customer on our mid\-tier package gets a live, round\-robin\-booked onboarding call.

  

We're hiring a Manager to own all three and decide, with evidence, how the team's time splits across them.


The operating model, segmentation, and capacity framework are already live — designed earlier this year. What's open is proving them out: testing capacity assumptions against real volume, turning usage and health signals into weekly targeting the team can act on, and finding where automation and AI genuinely help rather than add noise. If you like pressure\-testing a fresh model in the real world, this is the job. If you want a fully instrumented machine to optimise, it isn't.

**What you will do**

* **Run a multi\-motion coverage model**
* Own named coverage: a small CSM team working a defined portfolio — driving stalled adoption, securing renewals, stabilising at\-risk relationships.
* Own the digital long tail: triggered outreach, one\-to\-many programs, self\-serve enablement, a shared expansion queue, and clean hand\-offs to Support.
* Own onboarding: every eligible new customer gets a live first session; keep booking mechanics, volume, and completion rate healthy.
* Decide and defend the capacity split across the three. The current split is a working assumption — proving it out is one of your first jobs.

* **Build the digital program engine**
* Design programs that reach thousands of customers without a named owner: lifecycle campaigns, office hours, webinars, in\-product prompts, self\-serve paths.
* Decide where a human conversation earns its keep versus where a program does the job, and move the line as the evidence changes.
* Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Sales — most of this motion runs through channels CS doesn't own alone.

* **Turn signals into action**
* Read renewal load, expansion signals, and onboarding volume across the team every week, and act on them.
* Turn usage and health signals into thresholds: which patterns warrant a human conversation, which trigger a program, which are noise — sharpen these as you learn.
* Build reporting that gives an honest view of portfolio health, retention risk, and expected revenue movement.
* Feed what this team sees back into Product, Marketing, and Sales.

* **Use AI where it creates leverage**
* Apply AI to scale reach across the long tail and get more from the signals we already collect: health scoring, risk alerting, outreach personalisation, call prep.
* Ship AI where it genuinely changes the model's economics — don't run experiments that never launch. Use our internal AI ops team for support.
* Stay ahead of the curve on digital CS.

* **Develop the team commercially**
* Coach a small team who shift between three postures: individually accountable, program\-driven, high\-volume onboarding.
* Build skill in renewal, expansion, onboarding, and early risk conversations.
* Set expectations around outcomes — adoption improved, renewals secured, expansion surfaced — not activity cadences.
* Hire and develop as the team grows.

  
**Requirements**
----------------


Essential

* Experience running CS at scale — named coverage, pooled/tech\-touch, or a mix. Only run one? Show how you'd design and stand up the other.
* A track record of managing and developing people across genuinely different ways of working on one team.
* Real exposure to digital or programmatic CS within B2B SaaS: lifecycle campaigns, automated outreach, one\-to\-many enablement. You know what works at scale, not just what looks good in a deck.
* A commercial background or close to it: sales, RevOps, or a CS role carrying retention and expansion targets.
* Strong data literacy — the judgement to turn usage and health data into coverage decisions, not just dashboards.
* Practical AI fluency: you've put AI tools into a CS or RevOps workflow and made them stick.
* Comfort with a young operating model — you validate and adjust rather than wait for someone else to prove it first.


Nice to have

* Product\-led or high\-velocity SaaS experience, serving a large volume of smaller customers.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Intercom, round\-robin scheduling, or sales engagement platforms.
* RevOps, Sales Ops, or CS Ops background alongside people management.

  
**Benefits**
------------

* The chance to work with a very knowledgeable, high\-achieving and fun team.
* An international, diver

Overview:

About PowerSchool  

  

At PowerSchool, we power education for students around the world. As the global leader in cloud\-based K\-12 software, we support the full education ecosystem—from the central office to the classroom to the home. Joining PowerSchool means being part of a mission\-driven team that is transforming K\-12 education by helping schools operate more effectively and deliver better outcomes for educators, students, and families.### **Team Overview**


Our Success team ensures our partners in educational technology achieve their desired outcomes, serving as champions of our customers' needs. Through collaboration, strong relationships, and advocacy, the Success team positively impacts customer retention through proactive engagement and delivering excellence to our customers.
Responsibilities:
**Description**  

The Customer Success Manager is an expert in uncovering customer needs, risks, and opportunities through structured conversations and data\-driven analysis. This role is responsible for ensuring customers achieve successful outcomes, driving proactive retention strategies, and partnering closely with internal teams to strengthen renewal readiness and expansion opportunities.


This is an individual contributor role requiring strong critical thinking, influence without authority, and exceptional communication.


Your day\-to\-day job will consist of:

* **Customer Discovery \& Insight Development**:
* Lead deep‑dive investigative conversations with customer stakeholders to uncover goals, constraints, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Connect qualitative input with usage trends, support patterns, and operational data to form actionable insights.
* **Value Orchestration \& Retention Strategy:**
* Partner with cross\-functional teams (Support, Services, Product, Sales, and State/Partner teams) to execute retention playbooks and accelerate issue resolution.
* Ensure customers achieve measurable outcomes tied to renewal timelines and district priorities.
* **Adoption****\& Engagement Ownership****:**
* Guide customers through structured adoption programs mapped to maturity and product footprint.
* Identify and close adoption gaps, increase stakeholder engagement, and drive improvements in CSAT/NPS.
* **Risk Identification \& Mitigation:**
* Continuously evaluate customer health through data signals and leadership engagement quality.
* Proactively surface risks early and lead the creation of “Get to Green” plans with clear actions, owners, and success metrics.
* **Executive****Alignment****\& Value****Storytelling****:**

* **Growth \& Expansion Partnership**
* Identify expansion signals through investigative discovery and usage insights.
* Collaborate with Sales to build value‑based cases for expansion — Sales manages commercial negotiation; you provide insight and advocacy.
* **Forecasting****\& Reporting****:**
* Maintain accurate health and risk forecasts that inform renewal readiness.
* Deliver data\-driven recommendations to leadership on trending risks, adoption gaps, and strategic opportunities.
* **Process Improvement \& Change Agility**
* Contribute to refining scalable CSM processes and best practices.
* Navigate ambiguity with structured thinking, clear prioritization, and outcome\-driven decision\-making.
* **Customer Advocacy:**
* Serve as a senior point of escalation for adoption, value, or experience challenges.
* Advocate internally for durable solutions that strengthen long\-term partnership.


Qualifications:
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, or related roles in SaaS or technology\-enabled environments.
* Proven experience leading investigative customer conversations that reveal underlying needs, risks, and expansion opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to orchestrate cross\-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Experience with health/risk forecasting, renewal readiness, and account planning.
* Strong analytical and storytelling skills — ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Ability to travel regionally 30%\-45%

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with EdTech SaaS, K‑12 districts, public sector, or enterprise accounts.
* Familiarity with renewal motions and value\-based selling concepts; ability to craft outcome aligned narratives.
* Experience with Salesforce CRM, Co\-Pilot and other AI tools, and Customer Success platforms for health scoring, usage analysis, and risk management.


Compensation \& Benefits:

**Location:** Remote, based in MST or PST  
**Compensation:** $5,000/month base with a target total earnings of $6,500–$7,500/month, and uncapped variable compensation.

Metabolic Supply Group (MSG) is building a marketplace that connects healthcare providers with pharmacy partners and gives clinics a simpler way to source the products they need. We bring pharmacy relationships, ordering support, and dedicated account management together so providers can spend more time running their practices and caring for patients.

We’re growing quickly, and the people joining us now will help shape how we serve clinics and scale the business. You’ll work closely with the team, take ownership of meaningful relationships, and see the direct impact of your work on our customers and our growth.

**About the Role**

You’ll own an assigned portfolio of clinic accounts and be their primary contact for ongoing support and growth. Through proactive outreach and consistent follow\-through, you’ll help clinics become regular ordering partners, deepen existing relationships, and re\-engage inactive accounts.

You’ll work closely with sales, pharmacy operations, and administrative support to keep accounts moving, from the initial handoff through ongoing ordering and issue resolution. This role combines relationship management, commercial responsibility, and hands\-on coordination.

Professional fluency in English and Spanish is required. Based in the Mountain or Pacific time zone is preferred, complementing the geographic reach of our accounts.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Own your clinic relationships.** Build relationships with providers, practice managers, and clinic staff, developing a clear understanding of each account’s needs, ordering patterns, and growth opportunities.
* **Drive repeat orders and profitable growth.** Proactively engage clinics, identify opportunities to expand their use of approved products and services, and follow through on those opportunities.
* **Activate and re\-engage accounts.** Help newly assigned clinics begin ordering and reconnect with dormant or declining accounts to understand barriers and recover business.
* **Support the ordering experience.** Assist with order placement, answer account questions, and keep clinics informed about open requests and next steps.
* **Coordinate issues through resolution.** Work with pharmacy operations and pharmacy partners to address fulfillment and service concerns while remaining accountable for clinic communication and follow\-through.
* **Manage clear account handoffs.** Partner with sales to ensure newly assigned accounts have complete information, clear ownership, and a smooth transition into ongoing account management.
* **Communicate approved offerings.** Share product information, pricing, and promotions; follow established pricing and margin guidelines; and escalate questions that require additional expertise or approval.
* **Maintain accurate account information.** Document contacts, account activity, ordering history, follow\-ups, and outstanding issues in company systems.
* **Coordinate account support.** Use shared communication channels, collaborate with administrative support, and help clinics adopt portal\-based ordering.
* **Provide visibility into your portfolio.** Share account performance, growth opportunities, retention risks, and issues requiring attention.

**What You Bring**

* Professional fluency in English and Spanish, written and spoken.
* Two or more years of account management, customer success, or client relationship experience preferred.
* Healthcare experience strongly preferred, particularly in clinics or healthcare technology. Experience working with pharmacies or providers a plus.
* Ability to build strong relationships, identify growth opportunities, and retain accounts.
* Clear communication, strong organization, and reliable follow\-through.
* Comfort using CRM systems and digital tools to manage account activity.
* Independent judgment and ownership of account performance, including revenue and profitable growth.

**What Success Looks Like**

Your clinics know who to contact and trust you to follow through. Newly assigned and inactive accounts become consistent ordering partners. Your portfolio grows profitably, account risks are identified early, and clinic issues receive timely attention.

We’ll evaluate success through repeat ordering, account activation and reactivation, retention, portfolio revenue and profit, responsiveness, and accurate account documentation.

**Commission Structure**

The role offers a base of $5,000 per month, with target total earnings of $6,500–$7,500 per month through base and performance\-based variable compensation. Variable earnings are uncapped, giving you the opportunity to increase your compensation as you grow your assigned portfolio.

**How to Apply**

Please send an email to with the following:

* Subject Line: Bilingual Account Manager Interest (Your Name)
* Your resume or LinkedIn profile
* Your location and time zone, and;
* Two short answers:
* Tell us about your experience working with clinics, healthcare providers, or healthcare technology. What relationships or accounts did you personally manage?
* Describe an account you grew, reactivated, or retained when it was at risk. What did you do, and what was the result? Please omit confidential client information.

Pay: From $5,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:

**About Pearson**

At Pearson, we’re committed to a world that’s always learning and to our talented team who makes it all possible.


**Role summary**

The Advanced Specialist, Implementation Specialist role drives end\-to\-end item and test development for large\-scale K–12 statewide assessment programs. This role serves as a primary client\-facing leader for content development; translates standards and blueprints into high\-quality item/test specifications; and coordinates cross\-functional work with Psychometrics, Content, Publishing Services, Program Delivery, and Finance. The Senior TDM provides thought leadership on assessment design, ensures operational excellence across paper and online modalities, and helps deliver successful outcomes for programs.


**Key responsibilities**

**Assessment leadership and client consulting**

* Provide expert guidance on assessment design, content development, and evidence\-based practices for statewide assessments, including summative, interim, and other assessment types.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for client\-facing content development requirements and educator committee meetings.

**Blueprinting, item/test specifications, and development**

* Translate standards and blueprints into actionable item and test specifications; secure client approvals and maintain documentation.
* Partner with Psychometrics on blueprint setup, test construction, data reviews, and standard setting inputs.
* Configure item bank metadata and test maps and oversee form assembly for paper and online administrations.

**Scope, financial management and schedules**

* Create, monitor and update labor and non\-salary forecasts for programs; participate in forecast and finance reconciliation meetings.
* Lead scope discussions with content development vendors; initiate SOWs and coordinate escalations as needed.
* Maintain and approve content development schedules; manage change control and document updates in agreed tools.

**Risk and issue management**

* Identify and log project\-specific risks; develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Troubleshoot item/test development issues; lead sustainable corrective actions to protect quality and timelines.

**Communication and customer experience**

* Create and execute communication plans for consistent, transparent updates to customers.
* Facilitate customer review meetings on milestones and deliverables; establish and track customer satisfaction measures.
* Define escalation pathways and ensure timely resolution with clear, documented communication.

**Team leadership and collaboration**

* Coordinate staffing with Content leadership; provide performance feedback and coaching to team members and vendor partners.
* Foster a positive, cohesive team environment; model strong negotiation and cross\-functional collaboration.

**AI Strategy and Management**

* Leverage AI\-powered tools to support the development, review, and enhancement of assessment content, ensuring outputs meet quality and accessibility standards and comply with program\-specific security and privacy requirements.
* Collaborate with team members to integrate AI\-generated assets into assessment workflows, providing feedback and editorial oversight, and documenting provenance and approvals per established processes.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies relevant to educational content creation and assessment; share practical guidance with the team and surface tool recommendations for consideration.

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in the educational testing and assessment industry, including client\-facing work and cross\-functional team leadership.
* Demonstrated expertise in item and test development for statewide K–12 assessments; experience across paper and online modalities.
* Knowledge of psychometric principles relevant to development.
* Experience with statewide assessments; classroom teaching experience valued.
* Proficiency with project and financial planning.
* Strong vendor management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and time management skills
* Adaptability with enterprise systems and tools.
* Ability to travel throughout the year, with increased travel during summer months.

**AI\-Related** **Qualifications**

* Demonstrated excellence in AI\-supported content development to leverage AI effectively in asset creation within a managed, compliant workflow.
* Experience or familiarity with prompting, refining, and evaluating AI\-generated content for educational assessments, including applying accessibility and bias checks.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new AI tools and methodologies as they evolve.

jobs.description:
**Join the People Helping People**
==================================

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The company serves more than 4,000 financial institutions throughout North America, operating with velocity to help our clients keep pace with the rapid momentum of change and fuel growth in the new era of financial services. The Product Owner oversees the product backlog of existing and future features; fully driving all associated SDLC activities, specifically for the Contact Center \- desktop IVR/IVA. * Mentor and lead team members and work collaboratively; participates proactively and constantly in team activities with a focus on building a trusting and safe environment in partnership with the Scrum Master.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**



Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100\+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry\-leading AI and real\-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10’s SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.



At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.


**About the Role:**



We are seeking an experienced Display Media Account Manager to develop and execute digital media strategies on behalf of clients. As a Display Media Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving superior business results through strong relationship building, developing an in\-depth knowledge of the client’s business goals and objectives, understanding the categories in which they compete to strategically grow share, while providing solid reporting and analytics to demonstrate success against joint business plans. This role will be focused on Amazon DSP, with additional training responsibilities which are intended to educate our clients on DSP best practices, teach them how to build and manage an effective DSP strategy, and demonstrate how to integrate complex DSP campaigns into a cohesive, full\-funnel advertising program.



We are looking for a self\-starter with a proven track record of building relationships and taking full ownership of client inputs to deliver results. The ideal candidate will deliver an excellent client experience and execute at both a strategic and tactical level to deliver growth for our clients across various retail media platforms, with a heavy focus on Amazon DSP. This includes activities such as creating and managing display media strategies for various retailers, providing annual and ongoing budget recommendations to help clients achieve their business objectives, highlighting other operational KPIs or opportunities that impact advertising effectiveness, and delivering regular reporting on advertising effectiveness. This position requires a candidate who can easily dive deep into a data set, develop tactical strategies, and present their action plan to gain alignment with senior leaders.


**Responsibilities:**


* Fully own the client relationship by building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, and delivering results against joint business objectives
* Develop strategic growth plans, gain client alignment, and fully execute against the aligned upon approach
* Measure efficacy of the strategy through regular reporting against core retail media KPIs and ad\-hoc audits to identify areas for refinement
* Highlight incremental sales opportunities to clients through participation in retailer programs, additional promotional opportunities, and recommendations to improve operational KPIs
* Develop annual budget recommendations and properly allocate across campaigns to align with high level business objectives
* Develop an annual marketing calendar incorporating key drive periods (including relevant macro and micro seasons), new product launches, and clients’ national media calendars
* Leverage Pacvue technology to manage budget allocation, communicate with client on trends and pacing, and deliver results within client budget thresholds
* Prepare weekly and monthly retail media performance reports, analyze category trends, measure advertising and total sales, identify account trends, and perform competitive benchmarking across the client’s product portfolio
* Maximize retailer share, revenue, and profitability for clients while integrating client’s internal objectives such as driving innovation or key items or product lines
* Create strategic retail media plans for new product launches, including recommendations for retail readiness across core KPIs
* Act as Amazon DSP expert within broader Pacvue team, with potential to train and educate internal teams on DSP best practices
* Responsible for reporting, analysis, and communication with Pacvue and client management teams


**Skills \& Qualifications:**


* 3\-5\+ years’ experience working in eCommerce advertising, marketing, or sales
* 3\-5\+ years’ previous client\-facing account management experience
* An in\-depth knowledge of display media advertising, with prior Amazon DSP experience
* Demonstrate understanding of how retail media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive an eCommerce business
* Proven track record in relationship building and account management
* Proven success in driving results and implementing ideas in a fast\-paced environment
* Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes and workflows
* Excellent organizational and communication skills
* Strong analytical skills
* Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills are a must
* Previous product management, project management, financial analysis, negotiation and/or marketing experience is a plus


**Benefits:**


* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays
* Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance
* 401k with Employer Match
* Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization
* Paid Parental Leave
* Company\-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton
* Fertility and family\-building information platform through Carrot

jobs.description:
US Salary Range: $50,600 \- $60,000

**About Us**
============


Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033\. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end\-to\-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

**About the Role**
==================


We are looking to hire a Training Specialist to support Bonterra's Learning \& Training team by producing customer\-facing educational content and facilitating virtual learning experiences for nonprofit customers. This role is well\-suited for a learning professional who is building their instructional skills and is comfortable working from established templates, scripts, and guidelines. The Training Specialist is expected to execute assigned work reliably, ask good clarifying questions, and grow toward independent ownership of standard content types.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Host virtual customer events for Bonterra's nonprofit customers, delivering a professional, welcoming, and well\-paced online learning experience.
* Facilitate scripted live webinars for Bonterra customers, following standard agendas and lesson plans with accuracy and confidence.
* Produce educational videos using existing templates, scripts, and AI production tools (including Synthesia), applying provided QA checklists before any content is customer\-facing.
* Keep LMS content accurate and current so customers encounter up\-to\-date information.
* Answer customer questions during live sessions in a respectful and informative manner, escalating off\-script or complex questions appropriately.
* Communicate proactively when deliverable timelines are at risk.
* Collaborate with teammates and ask clarifying questions before beginning work to ensure the training produced addresses the actual customer need.
* Apply async\-first learning principles as guided, including structuring content for self\-paced consumption.

 **Required Skills \& Abilities**

* Ability to assess training needs through stakeholder consultation before developing or delivering content — treats each request as a starting point, not a confirmed solution.
* Ability to independently conduct basic needs assessments with internal stakeholders (e.g., Customer Success) for standard content types.
* Proficiency in developing training content from provided designs, templates, and scripts, with a working understanding of async\-first learning principles.
* Ability to facilitate live virtual training sessions from detailed guides, including managing unexpected questions in the moment and ensuring appropriate follow\-up.
* Ability to independently structure standard content types (feature walkthroughs, onboarding modules) for self\-paced consumption, including knowledge checks and removal of facilitator\-dependent interactions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with demonstrated comfort presenting to large virtual audiences.
* Strong attention to detail and time management, with a consistent ability to meet content deadlines and keep live sessions on schedule.
* Proficiency using AI production tools (e.g., Synthesia, Claude) in accordance with established templates and workflows.
* Commitment to quality assurance for AI\-generated content, including consistent use of QA checklists and proactive issue escalation prior to customer delivery.
* Ability to independently learn new tools through self\-directed exploration.
* Clear and proactive communicator who keeps immediate teammates informed and avoids creating blockers for cross\-functional partners.
* Ability to complete assigned deliverables on time, with a proactive approach to surfacing risks and requesting guidance when needed.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining consistent quality standards.

 **Technical \& Working Requirements**

* Reliable internet connection and professional home office setup suitable for virtual facilitation.
* Ability to present and facilitate remotely for extended periods.
* Comfort with video conferencing platforms (Zoom or equivalent) and virtual classroom management.

*At this time, we are unable to consider candidates who require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization.*

We firmly believe in the strength of collaboration, enthusiasm, generosity, and perseverance as the driving forces behind our success. With advisory solutions spanning accounting and risk, technology\-enabled transformation, and transactions, we partner with our clients to solve today’s challenges and deliver present and future value.  

Our commitment to our people has earned us numerous awards including Inc5000's Fastest Growing Companies and Glassdoor's Best Places to Work. Explore what our employees have to say about our unique culture by clicking here.  

By joining our rapidly growing Salesforce practice, you will serve as a trusted partner to our clients. You'll bring your first\-hand experience, unique perspectives, and functional knowledge to deliver tailored, integrated solutions that solve today's challenges and set the foundation for future success. With support from experienced leaders and a dedicated coach, you will join a collaborative community that invites you to contribute beyond the scope of client delivery.

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Business Analyst with 5–8 years of experience in a Salesforce consulting or professional services environment. This role is designed for an experienced, client\-facing professional who can independently lead business analysis activities, manage client relationships, and mentor junior team members. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Salesforce implementations, strong critical thinking skills, and the ability to drive client engagements from discovery through deployment — without the need for hands\-on configuration expertise.



### **What You'll Do:**


* Independently lead and facilitate discovery sessions, workshops, backlog grooming, sprint planning meetings, and stakeholder interviews to gather, validate, and prioritize business requirements.
* Build and manage strong client relationships, establishing trust with new clients and serving as a reliable point of contact throughout the project lifecycle.
* Partner with clients to understand business goals, identify gaps, risks, and considerations, and translate complex needs into clear user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Act as the key liaison between developers, Salesforce configurators, and non\-technical stakeholders, ensuring requirements are accurately understood and delivered across workstreams.
* Apply a user\-centric mindset to requirements gathering, documentation, QA support, and training activities to ensure solutions meet real business needs.
* Analyze complex business processes and break them down into smaller, manageable, and actionable requirements across the full project lifecycle — from discovery through deployment.
* Maintain and prioritize the product backlog, working with technical teams to refine user stories and define clear acceptance criteria.
* Support system integrations by identifying business needs and facilitating collaboration between client stakeholders and technical teams.
* Mentor and guide junior Business Analysts, sharing best practices and supporting their professional development.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of client\-facing deliverables, including process documentation, training materials, and status reports, with strong attention to detail.
* Evaluate and escalate project issues, risks, or conflicts proactively, offering thoughtful suggestions to ensure smooth project execution.
* Leverage firm\-approved AI tools — including emerging platforms — to support efficiency, quality, and innovation in the role, in accordance with company policies on data protection, intellectual property, and professional standards.
* Stay informed about emerging AI tools and techniques and collaborate with firm leadership to identify compliant opportunities to enhance client solutions and internal processes.
### **What You'll Bring:**


* 5–8 years of experience in a Salesforce consulting firm or professional services environment, supporting Salesforce implementation projects in a Business Analyst role.
* Proven ability to independently drive client\-facing meetings including discovery sessions, backlog grooming, and sprint planning — with minimal oversight.
* Strong client management skills, including the ability to establish and grow new client relationships from the ground up.
* Excellent liaison skills between developers and non\-technical stakeholders, with the ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.
* Solid understanding of the Salesforce platform, including core objects, the data model, and key product areas such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Experience Cloud — without the need for hands\-on configuration expertise.
* Demonstrated critical thinking skills, including the ability to validate requirements and proactively surface gaps, risks, and considerations.
* Experience facilitating requirements\-gathering sessions and translating business needs into user stories, process flows, and functional documentation.
* Strong familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and project management practices.
* Well\-organized, results\-driven, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced consulting environment across multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Excellent organizational, verbal, presentation/facilitation, and written communication skills — both internally and with clients.
* Comfort with AI: Demonstrated ability to responsibly explore and adopt firm\-approved AI tools, including AWS\-native tools such as Amazon Q, to enhance productivity and innovation.
* Continuous Learning Mindset: Openness to learning and applying emerging technologies, including AI and automation, in alignment with firm policies and client standards.

jobs.title: Contact Center Member Service Representative II (Sacramento)
jobs.description:
Contact center experience is a requirement for this role, banking experience is a plus. Candidates must be local to the Sacramento, CA area.
  
  

**Job Title:** Contact Center MSR II

**Department:** Member Service Contact Center
  
**Job Code:** 1104
  
**Pay Range:** $22\.50 \- $25\.00/HR
  
**Location:** Remote in Sacramento, CA area
  
  

**WHO WE ARE:**  

Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member\-owned, not\-for\-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.
  
  

**WHO YOU ARE:**  

You are a member\-focused financial services professional who thrives in a fast\-paced contact center environment and is passionate about delivering exceptional service. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Learn and retain an exceptional working knowledge of products and services.
* Meet and achieve established performance standards commensurate to grade level, with phone efficiency and quality in a fast\-paced environment.

* Identify, investigate, and resolve basic and complex member concerns, as well as process and complete member transactions in a timely and efficient manner.
* Identify and report fraudulent activity to prevent potential loss to Credit Union.
* Update member and Credit Union account information efficiently and accurately.
* Educate member on products in an effort to retain and enhance member loyalty.
* Maintains ownership with the majority of their calls, requiring minimal guidance from Support.
* Ability to de\-escalate situations, looking from several points of view and applying good judgement and critical thinking to resolve the situation.
* Assist members with Online/Mobile Banking complex issues and Mobile Wallet set\-up.
* Ability to open Sub shares.
* Complete Regulatory Training Modules as required.
* Model Golden 1 core values.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**QUALIFICIATIONS AND PREFERENCES:**  

* H.S. Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required
* Some college preferred
* 1\+ years customer service experience in a contact center environment required
* 2\+ years financial services experience required
* Member relationship building experience preferred

The Credit Union is committed a total rewards philosophy built on; a comprehensive compensation package, well\-being and work\-life balance, career development and growth, rewards and recognition, and a commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. We believe in fostering a workplace where every employee is recognized, valued, and motivated to contribute their best.

HMC Architects is an employee\-owned design firm with a desire to make a difference in our communities. As an employee owned company you become an owner after one year—receiving company\-provided shares at no cost and building long\-term financial growth as the firm succeeds. new_jobs.title: Music Content Operations AIML Program Lead
new_jobs.description:
A job at Apple is unlike any other you've had. You'll be challenged. You'll be inspired. And you'll be proud.  

  

Apple Music is looking for a Music Content Operations AIML Program Lead to help drive our strategic initiative to scale music content operations through models, agents, and automation. You'll lead the transition of music curation from a primarily manual operation toward a hybrid system where agents handle day\-to\-day work and human expertise is focused where it matters most \- high\-priority, high\-risk, and quality\-critical decisions. This is a full\-time individual contributor role on our Content Operations team, reporting into Music Content Operations leadership.  

  

Sitting at the intersection of operations and advanced technology, you'll serve as the technical liaison between our operational workflows and the data science and engineering teams building the models, tools, and agentic systems that scale this work far beyond what manual review can achieve alone. You'll partner with engineering to develop agents, help establish the key infrastructure to support and integrate them, and define how humans stay in the loop as that infrastructure matures. You'll translate messy operational reality \- everything from track\-level metadata quirks to editorial judgment calls \- into crisp technical requirements, evaluate the solutions that come back, and decide what ships.  

  

**Description**  

  

Own the strategy and execution plan to scale curation through models, agents, and automation \- sequencing workstreams by impact and driving them from concept to production. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to develop agents that take on day\-to\-day curation work, from defining requirements through evaluation and production rollout. Help establish the key infrastructure to support, integrate, and orchestrate agents over time \- shaping how agentic systems plug into existing curation workflows and data. Define the future operating model for curation \- determining where agents handle work autonomously and where humans stay in the loop for high\-priority, high\-risk, or quality\-assessment cases, including review of agent output. **NeoGenomics has an opening for a Senior Training Program Specialist, Commercial Education \& Effectiveness who wants to continue to learn in order to allow our company to grow. The ideal candidate will be located Remote Non\-CA with travel to Fort Myers for a week every other month.**

The Senior Training Program Specialist owns the operational backbone of the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness (CEE) training calendar. * Manage hotel, venue, and participant travel logistics for week\-long in\-person programs, including room blocks, meeting space, audiovisual requirements, food and beverage coordination, and accessibility needs.
* Partner with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session, owning the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness training workstream.
* Serve as the onsite point of contact during training programs, managing materials, shipping, badges, signage, room setup, and agenda changes.

* Build and maintain the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness SharePoint site, including document libraries, permissions, metadata, version control, and naming conventions.
* Audit and retire sales training content on a scheduled basis and coordinate required internal reviews for clinical, marketing, and claims\-related materials.
* Administer the learning platform, including curricula, enrollments, assignment rules, reporting, and learner record migration activities.
* Maintain accurate attendance, completion, assessment, and evaluation records and create post\-program reports.
* Utilize Microsoft Office and other digital tools to organize, track, and report training activities.
* Coordinate and facilitate communication within the commercial organization regarding training events, schedules, and updates.
* Support onboarding for new sales and support team members by ensuring system access and training resources are available before day one.

* Prepare manager touchpoint materials, including pre\-class briefing packets and post\-class coaching guides.
* Provide administrative support to the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness team and perform other duties as assigned.

--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Five or more years of experience in program or project coordination, corporate meeting and event planning, training coordination, or a sales or support role.
* Experience in a diagnostic laboratory, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare environment preferred.

**Why Mozilla?**



Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**About this team and role:**



Firefox Enterprise is a new team within Mozilla that is addressing the needs of business and government customers for a secure enterprise browser that gives organizations greater control over their data, policies, and digital infrastructure. We’re now seeking a **Strategic Account Manager, Firefox Enterprise** to help grow Firefox Enterprise in **France**. This is a high\-impact enterprise sales role for someone who is excited to build deep relationships with customers and help them achieve success using Firefox Enterprise.


**What you’ll do:**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term client relationships
* Understand our customer goals, challenges, and business needs
* Drive Firefox Enterprise adoption, engagement, and overall satisfaction across the account

* Coordinate with internal teams (Sales, Support, Product, Solution Engineering) to deliver a seamless customer experience
* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including additional seats, upgraded tiers, or new use cases

* Strong relationship\-building skills with the ability to establish trust and credibility at all levels of a customer organization

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French.

* + Welcoming differences

	+ Having grit

**What you’ll get:**


* Generous performance\-based bonus plans to all eligible employees \- we share in our success as one team

* Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
* Quarterly all\-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
* Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
* One\-time home office stipend
* Annual professional development budget
* Quarterly well\-being stipend
* Considerable paid parental leave
* Employee referral bonus program
* Other benefits (life/AD\&D, disability, EAP, etc. \- varies by country)

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity\-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.



We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior,

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Broadcast Media
new_jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.
  
The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.
  
  

**Location:** Preferred Northeast or Southeast
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to Media and Entertainment’s consulting projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, internal and external consultants and subject matter experts, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members. Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Coordinates all deliverable documentation between all internal and external stakeholders. Facilitates and directs document reviews to assure proper documentation is delivered to the client. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates transition of projects to later phase project teams.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence, and people management skills. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.


**Physical Demands:**  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee. The employee will experience normal office conditions and be required to use office equipment such as computers, peripherals, etc.
  
  

**Travel:**  

Some travel by car and occasional airplane trips should be expected as much of our consulting work is conducted remotely with occasional in person meetings. Employee must possess a valid driver’s license in their state of residence. Employee will be required to use their own vehicle and will be reimbursed for mileage at the current corporate rate. 10% remote travel is not unusual.
  
  

**Safety:**  

When meeting a client in person, Diversified requires SPMs t

new_jobs.title: Patient Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Skylark Sleep**

Skylark Sleep is a nationwide virtual sleep medicine practice delivering high\-quality, guideline\-based care for obstructive sleep apnea, insomnia, and related sleep disorders across all 50 states. We combine board\-certified sleep physicians, home sleep testing, oral appliance and PAP therapy management, and remote patient monitoring to make expert sleep care convenient and accessible. As we scale, we are building an operations team obsessed with a seamless, high\-touch patient experience from first contact through long\-term therapy.

**Position Summary**

The Patient Success Manager is a central member of the clinical operations team, working closely with and in direct support of the Clinic Operations Director. This role owns the day\-to\-day patient\-facing and behind\-the\-scenes coordination that keeps a virtual sleep clinic running smoothly: guiding patients through intake and onboarding, coordinating home sleep testing and therapy devices, managing scheduling and insurance workflows, and serving as a reliable point of contact throughout each patient's care journey. The ideal candidate is highly organized, service\-oriented, comfortable in a fast\-moving remote environment, and experienced in clinic operations.

**Patient Intake \& Onboarding**

* Be the welcoming, knowledgeable first point of contact who sets the tone for the patient experience.
* Guide new patients through registration, insurance verification, consent, and intake questionnaires, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate before their first visit.
* Verify insurance eligibility and benefits, obtain prior authorizations as needed, and partner with the billing/revenue cycle team to support clean documentation and timely claims.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records within the EHR system.

**Scheduling \& Care Coordination**

* Coordinate the shipment, tracking, and return of home sleep apnea testing (HSAT) devices, and support patients with setup and troubleshooting to ensure successful test completion.
* Coordinate PAP and oral appliance therapy logistics with clinical staff, DME suppliers, and dental partners.
* Schedule and manage telehealth visits, follow\-up appointments, and device fittings across multiple time zones.
* Act as a liaison between patients, clinicians, DME providers, and external partners to keep care moving without gaps, and proactively follow up to support therapy adherence and reduce no\-shows.
* Support enrollment and ongoing engagement in remote patient monitoring (RPM) and chronic care management programs, escalating clinical concerns as needed.

**Process \& Operations Support**

* Assist the Clinic Operations Director in refining intake workflows, standard operating procedures, and patient communication templates.
* Identify recurring friction points in the patient journey and recommend improvements.
* Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA and all applicable privacy, documentation, and telehealth standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a clinic operations or healthcare administrative environment.
* Demonstrated proficiency with electronic health record (EHR) systems and standard office/productivity software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm, patient\-centered approach.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Comfort working in a remote, technology\-driven environment and adapting to new tools and workflows.
* Reliable high\-speed internet and a private, HIPAA\-appropriate remote workspace.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with medical clinic billing, insurance verification, or prior authorization (strongly preferred).
* Background in sleep medicine, telehealth, DME, or remote patient monitoring.
* Experience supporting a multi\-state or virtual clinical practice.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive hourly compensation ($26\.00 – $28\.00/hour).
* Fully remote work environment.
* The opportunity to help build a patient experience from the ground up at a fast\-growing, mission\-driven sleep medicine company.
* A collaborative team that values initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement.

*Skylark Sleep is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

Pay: $25\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Healthcare management: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
**About WCG**
-------------



WCG delivers transformational solutions that accelerate clinical research and advance human health. We serve the experts, innovators, and pathfinders on the frontlines of science and medicine—empowering them to develop breakthrough therapies while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials.
**Why WCG**
-----------



At WCG, we invest in our people because you are the driving force behind our mission. When you grow, our impact grows. When you thrive, research accelerates. We empower you to build a meaningful career while advancing the work that improves lives.  

What we offer:
Comprehensive health and financial protection – Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accounts
  

Resources that support your whole life – Employee assistance programs and work/life balance tools
  

Investment in your growth – Referral bonuses, tuition reimbursement, on\-the\-job training, certification assistance, and continuing education support
  

Time to recharge – Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time
  

Pathways forward – Career development opportunities across One WCG
We practice transparency in everything we do, including compensation. The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission.
**Job Summary**
---------------


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to supporting data collection, the management
and analysis of documents, client reporting and problem resolution. This position will:
* Support the Board and clients by preparing documents for review in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements
* Provide accurate document identification and data entry
* Finalize and deliver documents to clients
* Meet assigned metrics around speed and accuracy
* Able to deal effectively with high work volume, rigid deadlines, and frequent changes
Specific job function requirements are outlined on training curriculum and addenda that supports step level 1 development in this position. Each function is made up of multiple duties. Specific criteria have been attributed to each duty to measure proficiency. As proficiency is proven in each duty, additional duties will be assigned for learning.
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.
* Ability to maintain and promote positive working relationships with clients (internal and external) by providing timely and professional service to their needs within the scope of company mission and accompanying regulations
* Maintain close attention to detail
* Ability to proof\-read and detect errors in typing, spelling, grammar, syntax, and punctuation
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as protocols for clinical investigations, medical, literature, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions
* Ability to set priorities and manage time effectively
* Accurately and completely enter information in a database system
* Contribute to a positive team environment through collaborative engagement with others
* Resolve questions and problems effectively
* Communicate to obtain information or clarify requests
* Mentor team members by teaching procedures, monitoring, and proofing work, and providing constructive feedback as needed or requested
* Is able to assist others across Operations, as needed. This may include overtime requests, training support, etc.
* Professional/oral written communication skills
* Independent worker
* Accountable for self\-metrics
* Attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the position.
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here.
**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**
* Bachelors or Associates Degree preferred, or a combination of equivalent education and experience
**QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE:**
* Two\+ years of experience working in an office setting where proofing documents and attention to detail are essential elements of your job requirements
* Must have strong analytical skills with a high degree of accuracy in work
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Databases and Adobe
* Knowledge of FDA regulations as they relate to research (preferred)
* Must be able to maintain confidentiality
* Experience working with medical terminology (preferred)
* Ability to work independently, utilize discretionary judgment, and be a pro\-active team player
* Exhibit excellence in:
	+ Communication \- Proficient verbal and written communication skills. Willingness to share and receive information and ideas from all levels of the organization in order to achieve the desired results.
	+ Customer service\- understanding the importance of meeting client requests and adapting to changing needs
	+ Teamwork \- Commitment to the successful achievement of team and organizational goals through a desire to participate with and help other members of the team
**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:** 0% \- 5%
Physical and Sensory Requirements:

new_jobs.description:
**Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** has an exciting career opportunity available as an **Operations Manager II for the Referral Management \& Analytics** **Service Line**. This position will over see the Southern Region.
This role operates within the Referral Management \& Analytics service line and requires demonstrated experience leading operations in a high\-volume, physician\-referral\-driven healthcare environment. The ideal candidate will have experience managing distinct teams focused on both referral coordination and outreach, and data\-driven analytics used to identify volume trends, at\-risk referral sources, and growth opportunities. This role requires deep expertise in navigating physician office relationships, referral workflow and EMR/ordering systems, and the reporting frameworks needed to translate referral data into actionable retention and growth strategies.
This role serves as the face of Elevate PFS to our hospital clients on a day to day basis. The purpose of this position is to lead and manage all operational staff and client portfolios encompassing the assigned area within the division of the applicable service line(s). Ownership of staff and associate procedures, clients and associated relationships, and revenue and cost functions is crucial.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
* Responsible for day to day operations of staff and client needs.
* Manage and orient staff; assigns work, develops work schedules, instructs in proper procedures; assists with development and revision of department processes/procedures.
* Monitor staff performance, provides employee recognition and feedback.
* Address and resolve personnel issues in a timely and effective manner.
* Document issues and concerns to their upline leader(s).
* Work collaboratively with upline leadership to establish staff goals.
* Oversee the performance appraisal process to support performance and development.
* Monitor overall project performance and provides monthly analysis of certification performance; reports findings and implements solutions when negative trends are noted.
* Monitor billing procedures and documentation and provides updates with regulatory compliance; conducts periodic audits; and maintains files.
* Develop relationships with clients and county agencies.
* When necessary, partner with Client Services to discuss and address client concerns/issues immediately as they arise.
* Ensure all communication from patients and providers have timely follow\-up and resolution of complaints and concerns.
* Provide adequate training needs to the staff related to policies/procedures or government regulations.
* Represent Elevate PFS at client department meetings.
* Develop and implement effective communication channels to provide information to all staff members.
* Work collaboratively with other facets of the operations which includes Disability, AR Services, Early Out, IT and HR.
* Lead succession planning efforts to ensure organizational continuity.
* Execute strategic initiatives aligned with Company goals.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications and Requirements**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities.
* High School Diploma or GED; Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Minimum of 2 years of management experience, managing at least 5 people
* Hospital revenue cycle experience preferred
* Familiarization with state and federal programs
* Strong leadership and communication skills, high service orientation and strong computer system and analytical skills are required.
* Excellent time management skills
* Accustomed to working in a rapidly changing environment
* Experience with Hospital systems such as STAR, EPIC, Cerner, Meditech, etc.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn computer applications
* Knowledge of HIPAA, ACA and EMTALA regulations
* Excellent communication skills both written and oral
* Remote and Hybrid positions require home internet connections that meet the Company’s upload and download speed criteria.


**Benefits**  

ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees –the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well\-being of our employees and their families.
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* 401K (100% match for the first 3% \& 50% match for the next 2%)
* 15 days of PTO
* 7 paid Holidays
* 2 Floating holidays
* 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday)
* Pet Insurance
* Employee referral bonus program
* Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together
* Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles

The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
OptioRx is a dynamic premier national compounding pharmacy providing best in class patient care. We serve 50 states and are committed to fostering a team environment rooted in trust, innovation, efficiency, accountability, integrity, and energy.

**Summary:**

The Project Coordinator supports the planning and delivery of facility, operational, and enterprise projects by coordinating schedules, meetings, documentation, action items, risks, and stakeholder communications. Working closely with project managers, project owners, internal teams, and external partners, this role helps maintain accurate project records, monitor progress, and ensure assigned activities are completed on time. The Project Coordinator is expected to be highly organized, detail\-oriented, responsive, and proactive in escalating issues that may affect scope, schedule, budget, quality, compliance, or operational readiness.

· Support project managers and project owners in developing, maintaining, and updating project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder assignments.

· Coordinate project meetings by preparing agendas and materials, documenting decisions and meeting minutes, and distributing action items with assigned owners and due dates.

· Monitor project activities, deadlines, risks, issues, changes, approvals, and follow\-up items, and promptly escalate delays, barriers, or concerns that may affect project execution.

· Maintain accurate, current, and well\-organized project documentation, including plans, status reports, correspondence, decisions, approvals, supporting records, and shared project resources.

· Collect status updates from project team members and prepare routine dashboards, reports, and summaries that provide project managers and stakeholders with clear visibility into progress and next steps.

· Support project budget and expense tracking by collecting invoices, purchase information, forecasts, and variance details in partnership with project managers and Finance.

· Coordinate communications, logistics, resources, onboarding activities, readiness checklists, training schedules, and implementation or launch support with internal departments, vendors, contractors, and external partners.

· Follow established EPMO standards, templates, governance processes, and document\-control requirements to support consistent project execution and reporting.

· Identify opportunities to improve project visibility, accountability, documentation quality, stakeholder communication, and team coordination.

· Support project closeout activities by confirming completion of assigned deliverables, organizing final documentation, capturing lessons learned, and assisting with transition or handoff activities as appropriate.

· Assist with periodic portfolio, executive, shareholder, or Board reporting by gathering, organizing, and validating project information.

· Support project reviews, site visits, implementation activities, post\-project closeout tasks, and other project events as needed.

· Maintain shared project workspaces, templates, trackers, contact lists, and resource libraries to support consistent team access to project materials.

· Perform additional project coordination, reporting, documentation, and administrative duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

· Associate or bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

· 1 \- 3 years of experience in project coordination, project administration, operations, or a related support role preferred.

· Demonstrated ability to coordinate meetings, maintain schedules and trackers, prepare clear documentation, and follow through on multiple priorities.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work professionally across departments and organizational levels.

· Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, time management, and sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications required; experience with Teams, SharePoint, Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, Asana, or similar tools preferred.

· Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, construction, information technology, or another regulated environment preferred.

· CAPM, Certified Associate in Scrum Fundamentals, Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt, or similar entry\-level credential preferred but not required.
